```cpp
//    GNU General Public License for more details.                          //
/****************************************************************************/

#include "../../ff7.h"
#include "../../gl.h"
#include "../../log.h"
#include "../defs.h"
#include "kawai.h"
#include "model.h"

#include <unordered_map>
#include <bx/math.h>

namespace ff7::field
{
    namespace
    {
        struct ModelEffect
        {
            kawai::State state;
            kawai::Effect draw_effect;
            std::array<kawai::Effect, 2> packet_effects{};
            std::array<uint8_t, 32> params{};
            size_t parameter_count = 0;
            int opcode = -1;
            bool pending = false;
            bool applied = false;
            int splash_frame = 0;
            hrc_data* model = nullptr;
            struc_110* instance = nullptr;
        };

        struct Binding
        {
            ff7_polygon_set* polygon_set;
        };

        std::array<ModelEffect, FF7_MAX_NUM_MODEL_ENTITIES> models{};
        std::unordered_map<polygon_data*, Binding> bindings;
        int current_model = -1;
        size_t current_packet = 0;
        int packet_frame = 0;

        kawai::Vector to_psx(const vector3<float>& position)
        {
            return {position.x, -position.z, position.y};
        }

        vector3<float> to_pc(const kawai::Vector& position)
        {
            return {position[0], position[2], -position[1]};
        }

        std::optional<kawai::gte::Matrix> fixed_model_rotation(const matrix& model, const matrix& inverse_camera)
        {
            kawai::gte::Matrix result{};
            vector3<float> world;
            for (size_t column = 0; column < 3; ++column)
            {
                kawai::Vector axis{};
                axis[column] = 1;
                const auto local = to_pc(axis);
                vector3<float> direction = {
                    local.x * model._11 + local.y * model._21 + local.z * model._31,
                    local.x * model._12 + local.y * model._22 + local.z * model._32,
                    local.x * model._13 + local.y * model._23 + local.z * model._33};
                world = {
                    direction.x * inverse_camera._11 + direction.y * inverse_camera._21 + direction.z * inverse_camera._31,
                    direction.x * inverse_camera._12 + direction.y * inverse_camera._22 + direction.z * inverse_camera._32,
                    direction.x * inverse_camera._13 + direction.y * inverse_camera._23 + direction.z * inverse_camera._33};
                for (float value : {world.x, world.y, world.z})
                    if (!std::isfinite(value) || std::abs(value) > 2147483000.0f) return std::nullopt;
                const auto fixed = kawai::fixed_normal(kawai::normalize({world.x, world.y, world.z}));
                for (size_t row = 0; row < 3; ++row) result[row][column] = fixed[row];
            }
            return result;
        }

        kawai::gte::Affine fixed_camera_matrix(const matrix& camera)
        {
            kawai::gte::Affine result;
            for (size_t row = 0; row < 3; ++row)
            {
                for (size_t column = 0; column < 3; ++column)
                    result.rotation[row][column] = kawai::gte::word(std::llround(camera.m[column][row] * 4096));
                result.translation[row] = kawai::gte::long_word(std::llround(camera.m[3][row]));
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    KawaiModelScope::KawaiModelScope(struc_110* instance) : previous_model(current_model)
    {
        current_model = -1;
        if (getmode_cached()->driver_mode != MODE_FIELD) return;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < models.size(); ++i)
            if (models[i].instance == instance)
            {
                current_model = static_cast<int>(i);
                break;
            }
    }

    KawaiModelScope::~KawaiModelScope()
    {
        current_model = previous_model;
    }

    bool queue_kawai_effect(int model_id, uint8_t opcode, std::span<const uint8_t> params)
    {
        if (model_id < 0 || model_id >= FF7_MAX_NUM_MODEL_ENTITIES)
        {
            ffnx_error("KAWAI: invalid model id %d\n", model_id);
            return false;
        }
        auto& model = models[model_id];
        if (!kawai::handles(opcode))
        {
            model.pending = false;
            if (opcode == 0xE || opcode == 0xD || opcode == 0xFF)
            {
                model.state = {};
                model.draw_effect = {};
                model.packet_effects = {};
                model.applied = false;
            }
            return false;
        }
        model.opcode = opcode;
        model.pending = true;
        model.parameter_count = std::min(params.size(), model.params.size());
        std::copy_n(params.begin(), model.parameter_count, model.params.begin());
        return true;
    }

    bool apply_kawai_effect(int model_id, int opcode, ff7_hrc_polygon_data* model_data, int* result, int* complete)
    {
        if (model_id < 0 || model_id >= FF7_MAX_NUM_MODEL_ENTITIES || opcode < 0 || opcode > 0xFF) return false;
        const auto subcode = static_cast<uint8_t>(opcode);
        if (!kawai::handles(subcode)) return false;
        auto& model = models[model_id];
        if (model.pending && model.opcode == opcode)
        {
            auto candidate = model.state;
            if (!kawai::configure(candidate, subcode,
                std::span(model.params).first(model.parameter_count)))
            {
                ffnx_error("KAWAI: invalid %02X parameters or execute without initialization for model %d\n", opcode, model_id);
                model.state = {};
                model.draw_effect = {};
                model.packet_effects = {};
                model.pending = false;
                *result = -1;
                *complete = 1;
                return true;
            }
            model.state = candidate;
            model.pending = false;
            if (trace_all || trace_opcodes)
                ffnx_trace("KAWAI[%02X]: model=%d,executing=%d,parameter_count=%zu\n",
                    opcode, model_id, model.state.executing, model.parameter_count);
        }
        if (model_data && model_data->hrc_data)
        {
            model.model = model_data->hrc_data;
            model.instance = &model_data->struc_110;
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < model.model->num_bones; ++i)
            {
                auto& bone = model.model->bones[i];
                if (!bone.rsd_array) continue;
                for (uint32_t j = 0; j < bone.num_rsd; ++j)
                {
                    auto* rsd = bone.rsd_array[j].rsd_data;
                    if (rsd && rsd->polygon_set && rsd->polygon_set->polygon_data)
                        bindings[rsd->polygon_set->polygon_data] = {rsd->polygon_set};
                }
            }
        }
        model.applied = model.state.executing || (model.state.initialized && model.state.opcode == 0xC);
        const bool direct = opcode >= 2 && opcode <= 5;
        *result = direct ? -1 : opcode;
        *complete = !model.state.executing || direct ||
            ((opcode == 6 || opcode == 8) && model.state.fade.finished);
        if (opcode == 9 && model.state.executing &&
            model.splash_frame++ % std::max(common_frame_multiplier, 1) != 0)
            return true;
        // SPLASH retains the native particle state machine; only its coloring is replaced.
        return opcode != 9;
    }

    void advance_kawai_effects(int frame_multiplier)
    {
        for (auto& model : models)
        {
            if (model.applied)
            {
                auto effect = model.state.effect;
                // PSX 0C initialization hides normal packets until its projected renderer executes.
                if (model.state.opcode == 0xC && !model.state.executing)
                    effect.kind = kawai::Kind::hidden;
                // AMBNT and LIGHT write only the active PSX packet buffer, including the final fade value.
                if (model.state.opcode == 2 || model.state.opcode == 6)
                    model.packet_effects[current_packet] = effect;
                else
                    model.packet_effects.fill(effect);
                kawai::advance(model.state, frame_multiplier);
            }
            model.draw_effect = model.packet_effects[current_packet];
            model.applied = false;
        }
        if (++packet_frame >= std::max(frame_multiplier, 1))
        {
            packet_frame = 0;
            current_packet ^= 1;
        }
    }

    void reset_kawai_effects()
    {
        models = {};
        bindings.clear();
        current_model = -1;
        current_packet = 0;
        packet_frame = 0;
        current_state.kawai_effect = {};
    }

    bool bind_kawai_effect(polygon_data* polygon)
    {
        current_state.kawai_effect = {};
        const auto found = bindings.find(polygon);
        if (found == bindings.end() || current_model < 0) return false;
        auto& model = models[current_model];
        if (model.draw_effect.kind == kawai::Kind::none || !model.model) return false;
        if (!*ff7_externals.field_level_data_pointer || !*ff7_externals.field_camera_data)
        {
            ffnx_error("KAWAI: field camera is unavailable\n");
            return false;
        }
        current_state.kawai_effect = model.draw_effect;
        if (current_state.kawai_effect.kind == kawai::Kind::positional_lighting)
        {
            int64_t radius = current_state.kawai_effect.light_radius;
            bool found_part = false;
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < model.model->num_bones && !found_part; ++i)
            {
                const auto& bone = model.model->bones[i];
                if (!bone.rsd_array) continue;
                for (uint32_t j = 0; j < bone.num_rsd; ++j)
                {
                    const auto* rsd = bone.rsd_array[j].rsd_data;
                    if (!rsd || !rsd->polygon_set || !rsd->polygon_set->field_0) continue;
                    ++radius;
                    if (rsd->polygon_set->polygon_data == polygon)
                    {
                        found_part = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!found_part)
            {
                current_state.kawai_effect = {};
                ffnx_error("KAWAI: positional-light model part is unavailable\n");
                return false;
            }
            current_state.kawai_effect.light_radius = kawai::gte::word(radius);
        }
        ff7_get_field_view_matrix(&current_state.kawai_camera_matrix);
        return true;
    }

    bool has_kawai_splash_color()
    {
        const int id = ff7_kawai_current_model_id;
        return id >= 0 && id < models.size() && models[id].state.initialized && models[id].state.opcode == 9;
    }

    KawaiGeometry process_kawai_geometry(std::span<const nvertex> vertices,
        std::span<const vector3<float>> normals, std::span<const uint32_t> indices,
        std::span<const uint32_t> source_colors, light_data* light)
    {
        KawaiGeometry output;
        const auto& effect = current_state.kawai_effect;
        if (effect.kind == kawai::Kind::hidden) return output;
        if (indices.size() % 3 != 0 || (!normals.empty() && normals.size() != vertices.size()))
        {
            ffnx_error("KAWAI: inconsistent triangle or normal arrays\n");
            return {};
        }
        const bool custom_lighting = effect.kind == kawai::Kind::lighting ||
            effect.kind == kawai::Kind::positional_lighting;
        const bool gpu_color = kawai::gpu_color_offset(effect,
            light && !normals.empty() && game_lighting != GAME_LIGHTING_ORIGINAL);
        if ((gpu_color || custom_lighting || effect.kind == kawai::Kind::gradient || (effect.flags & 1)) &&
            source_colors.size() != vertices.size())
        {
            ffnx_error("KAWAI: source vertex colors are unavailable for this primitive\n");
            return {};
        }
        if (custom_lighting && normals.size() != vertices.size())
        {
            ffnx_error("KAWAI: normals are unavailable for custom lighting\n");
            return {};
        }
        matrix inverse;
        matrix inverse_camera;
        for (const auto& row : current_state.kawai_camera_matrix.m)
            for (float component : row)
                if (!std::isfinite(component) || std::abs(component) > 2147483000.0f)
                {
                    ffnx_error("KAWAI: invalid field camera transform\n");
                    return {};
                }
        bx::mtxInverse(inverse_camera.m[0], current_state.kawai_camera_matrix.m[0]);
        for (const auto& row : current_state.world_view_matrix.m)
            for (float component : row)
                if (!std::isfinite(component))
                {
                    ffnx_error("KAWAI: non-finite model transform\n");
                    return {};
                }
        const auto world_rotation = fixed_model_rotation(current_state.world_view_matrix, inverse_camera);
        if (!world_rotation)
        {
            ffnx_error("KAWAI: invalid fixed-point model transform\n");
            return {};
        }
        const auto camera_matrix = fixed_camera_matrix(current_state.kawai_camera_matrix);
        const auto camera_rotation = kawai::gte::compose(camera_matrix, {*world_rotation, {}}).rotation;
        const auto directions = kawai::gte::compose({kawai::light_directions(effect), {}},
            {camera_rotation, {}}).rotation;
        const auto plane_model = kawai::gte::to_plane(effect.plane, {});
        const auto plane_camera = kawai::gte::from_plane(effect.plane, camera_matrix);
        const bool cpu_lighting = light && game_lighting != GAME_LIGHTING_ORIGINAL &&
            (effect.kind == kawai::Kind::color_offset || effect.kind == kawai::Kind::below_level ||
                effect.kind == kawai::Kind::gradient);
        kawai::Effect base_lighting;
        if (cpu_lighting)
        {
            base_lighting.color = {128 * light->global_light_color.r, 128 * light->global_light_color.g,
                128 * light->global_light_color.b};
            const std::array<bgra_color, 3> colors = {light->light_color_1, light->light_color_2, light->light_color_3};
            const std::array<vector3<float>, 3> directions = {light->light_dir_1, light->light_dir_2, light->light_dir_3};
            for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
            {
                base_lighting.light_colors[i] = {128 * colors[i].r, 128 * colors[i].g, 128 * colors[i].b};
                base_lighting.light_directions[i] = {-directions[i].x, -directions[i].y, -directions[i].z};
            }
            const kawai::Vector scripted = {light->scripted_light_color.r, light->scripted_light_color.g,
                light->scripted_light_color.b};
            for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
            {
                base_lighting.color[i] *= scripted[i];
                for (auto& color : base_lighting.light_colors) color[i] *= scripted[i];
            }
        }
        if (effect.kind == kawai::Kind::clip)
        {
            const auto& m = current_state.world_view_matrix;
            const float determinant = m._11 * (m._22 * m._33 - m._23 * m._32) -
                m._12 * (m._21 * m._33 - m._23 * m._31) + m._13 * (m._21 * m._32 - m._22 * m._31);
            if (std::abs(determinant) < 1e-8f)
            {
                ffnx_error("KAWAI: cannot project a model with a singular transform\n");
                return {};
            }
            bx::mtxInverse(inverse.m[0], current_state.world_view_matrix.m[0]);
        }
        output.vertices.reserve(indices.size());
        if (!normals.empty()) output.normals.reserve(indices.size());

        for (size_t triangle = 0; triangle + 2 < indices.size(); triangle += 3)
        {
            std::array<nvertex, 3> primitive;
            std::array<kawai::Vector, 3> positions;
            std::array<kawai::gte::LongVector, 3> camera_positions;
            bool visible = false;
            for (size_t corner = 0; corner < 3; ++corner)
            {
                const auto index = indices[triangle + corner];
                if (index >= vertices.size())
                {
                    ffnx_error("KAWAI: vertex index %u exceeds vertex count %zu\n", index, vertices.size());
                    return {};
                }
                primitive[corner] = vertices[index];
                vector3<float> posed;
                transform_point(&current_state.world_view_matrix, &primitive[corner]._, &posed);
                // The native model-view matrix already maps PC local axes into PSX camera axes.
                vector3<float> world;
                transform_point(&inverse_camera, &posed, &world);
                kawai::gte::LongVector world_position{};
                const kawai::Vector coordinates = {world.x, world.y, world.z};
                // PC meshes are reauthored floating-point geometry, not PSX SVECTORs.
                // Quantize the posed field coordinates, not their small local vertices.
                for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
                {
                    if (!std::isfinite(coordinates[i]) || std::abs(coordinates[i]) > 2147483000.0f)
                    {
                        ffnx_error("KAWAI: invalid model vertex coordinates\n");
                        return {};
                    }
                    world_position[i] = static_cast<int32_t>(std::floor(coordinates[i]));
                }
                camera_positions[corner] = kawai::gte::transform_world(camera_matrix, world_position);
                const auto transformed = effect.kind == kawai::Kind::gradient && (effect.flags & 0x10) ?
                    camera_positions[corner] : world_position;
                for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) positions[corner][i] = static_cast<float>(transformed[i]);
                if (effect.kind == kawai::Kind::clip)
                {
                    const auto plane_position = kawai::gte::transform_world(plane_model, world_position);
                    kawai::gte::Vector projected = {kawai::gte::ir(plane_position[0]),
                        kawai::gte::ir(plane_position[1]), kawai::gte::ir(plane_position[2])};
                    visible |= kawai::gte::project(projected, effect.plane);
                    const auto projected_camera = kawai::gte::transform(plane_camera, projected);
                    vector3<float> point = {static_cast<float>(projected_camera[0]),
                        static_cast<float>(projected_camera[1]), static_cast<float>(projected_camera[2])};
                    transform_point(&inverse, &point, &primitive[corner]._);
                }
            }
            if (effect.kind == kawai::Kind::clip && !visible) continue;
            const auto average = kawai::triangle_average(positions);
            for (size_t corner = 0; corner < 3; ++corner)
            {
                const auto index = indices[triangle + corner];
                auto& vertex = primitive[corner];
                if (gpu_color)
                {
                    // AMBNT tints albedo; only LIGHT is composed after lighting.
                    vertex.color.color = (vertex.color.color & 0xFF000000) | (source_colors[index] & 0xFFFFFF);
                    if (!effect.color_fade)
                        vertex.color.color = kawai::apply_color_offset(effect, positions[corner], vertex.color.color, source_colors[index]);
                }
                else if (effect.kind == kawai::Kind::color_offset ||
                    effect.kind == kawai::Kind::below_level || effect.kind == kawai::Kind::gradient)
                {
                    const bool relit = cpu_lighting && index < normals.size();
                    if (relit)
                    {
                        if (index < source_colors.size())
                            vertex.color.color = (vertex.color.color & 0xFF000000) | (source_colors[index] & 0xFFFFFF);
                        matrix rotation = current_state.world_view_matrix;
                        rotation._41 = rotation._42 = rotation._43 = 0;
                        auto normal = normals[index];
                        vector3<float> camera_normal;
                        transform_point(&rotation, &normal, &camera_normal);
                        auto camera_rotation = inverse_camera;
                        camera_rotation._41 = camera_rotation._42 = camera_rotation._43 = 0;
                        vector3<float> world_normal;
                        transform_point(&camera_rotation, &camera_normal, &world_normal);
                        vertex.color.color = kawai::enhanced_light_color(vertex.color.color, base_lighting,
                            kawai::normalize({world_normal.x, world_normal.y, world_normal.z}));
                    }
                    const bool per_vertex = effect.kind == kawai::Kind::gradient ? current_state.shademode != 0 :
                        (effect.flags & 2) != 0;
                    const auto& position = per_vertex ? positions[corner] : average;
                    // 0B adds its gradient after lighting, without restoring the unlit material color.
                    const auto source = relit && effect.kind == kawai::Kind::gradient ? vertex.color.color :
                        (index < source_colors.size() ? source_colors[index] : vertex.color.color);
                    vertex.color.color = kawai::apply_color_offset(effect, position, vertex.color.color, source);
                }
                else if (custom_lighting)
                {
                    const size_t lighting_corner = current_state.shademode ? corner : 0;
                    const auto lighting_index = indices[triangle + lighting_corner];
                    const auto normal = to_psx(normals[lighting_index]);
                    for (float component : normal)
                        if (!std::isfinite(component) || std::abs(component) > 524000)
                        {
                            ffnx_error("KAWAI: invalid model normal\n");
                            return {};
                        }
                    auto local_directions = directions;
                    if (effect.kind == kawai::Kind::positional_lighting)
                    {
                        const auto direction = kawai::gte::point_direction(effect.light_position, effect.light_radius,
                            camera_positions[lighting_corner], camera_rotation);
                        if (!direction)
                        {
                            ffnx_error("KAWAI: invalid positional-light radius or squared distance\n");
                            return {};
                        }
                        local_directions = {};
                        local_directions[0] = *direction;
                    }
                    vertex.color.color = kawai::light_color((vertex.color.color & 0xFF000000) |
                        (source_colors[lighting_index] & 0xFFFFFF), effect, kawai::fixed_normal(normal), local_directions);
                }
                output.vertices.push_back(vertex);
                if (!normals.empty()) output.normals.push_back(normals[index]);
            }
        }
        return output;
    }

    bool draw_kawai_model(polygon_data* polygon, indexed_primitive* primitive,
        std::span<const vector3<float>> normals, light_data* light, uint32_t clip,
        std::span<const uint32_t> source_colors)
    {
        if (current_state.kawai_effect.kind == kawai::Kind::none) return false;
        const auto found = bindings.find(polygon);
        if (source_colors.empty() && found != bindings.end() && polygon->vertexcolordata)
        {
            auto* polygon_set = found->second.polygon_set;
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < polygon_set->numgroups; ++i)
                if (polygon_set->indexed_primitives[i] == primitive)
                {
                    source_colors = {reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(polygon->vertexcolordata) +
                        polygon->groupdata[i].offvert, primitive->vertexcount};
                    break;
                }
        }
        std::vector<uint32_t> indices(primitive->indices, primitive->indices + primitive->indexcount);
        auto geometry = process_kawai_geometry({primitive->vertices, primitive->vertexcount}, normals, indices, source_colors, light);
        for (size_t start = 0; start < geometry.vertices.size(); start += 65535)
        {
            const auto count = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::min<size_t>(65535, geometry.vertices.size() - start));
            std::vector<WORD> batch_indices(count);
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) batch_indices[i] = static_cast<WORD>(i);
            auto* batch_normals = geometry.normals.empty() ? nullptr : geometry.normals.data() + start;
            const bool cpu_color = current_state.kawai_effect.kind != kawai::Kind::clip &&
                !kawai::gpu_color_offset(current_state.kawai_effect,
                    light && batch_normals && game_lighting != GAME_LIGHTING_ORIGINAL);
            gl_draw_indexed_primitive(primitive->primitivetype, primitive->vertextype,
                geometry.vertices.data() + start, batch_normals, count,
                batch_indices.data(), count, nullptr, polygon->boundingboxdata, cpu_color ? nullptr : light, clip, true);
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```h
/****************************************************************************/
//    Copyright (C) 2009 Aali132                                            //
//    Copyright (C) 2018 quantumpencil                                      //

//    the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License         //
//                                                                          //
//    FFNx is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,               //
//    but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of        //
//    MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.  See the         //
//    GNU General Public License for more details.                          //
/****************************************************************************/

#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <bit>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
#include <vector>
#include "kawai_gte.h"

namespace ff7::field::kawai
{
    using Vector = std::array<float, 3>;

    enum class Kind
    {
        none,
        color_offset,
        below_level,
        gradient,
        lighting,
        positional_lighting,
        clip,
        hidden
    };

    struct Effect
    {
        Kind kind = Kind::none;
        Vector color{};
        Vector target_color{};
        float level = 0;
        float target_level = 0;
        int16_t gradient_range = 0;
        uint8_t flags = 0;
        bool color_fade = false;
        std::array<Vector, 3> light_colors{};
        std::array<Vector, 3> light_directions{};
        gte::Plane plane{};
        gte::Vector light_position{};
        int16_t light_radius = 0;
    };

    struct Fade
    {
        std::array<int16_t, 4> value{};
        std::array<int16_t, 4> target{};
        std::array<int16_t, 4> step{};
        bool finished = false;
        int frame = 0;
    };

    struct State
    {
        Effect effect{};
        Fade fade{};
        uint8_t opcode = 0;
        bool initialized = false;
        bool executing = false;
    };

    inline int16_t signed_word(int value)
    {
        return std::bit_cast<int16_t>(static_cast<uint16_t>(value));
    }

    inline int16_t read_s16(std::span<const uint8_t> params, size_t offset)
    {
        return signed_word(static_cast<uint16_t>(params[offset]) |
            (static_cast<uint16_t>(params[offset + 1]) << 8));
    }

    inline bool handles(uint8_t opcode)
    {
        return opcode == 2 || opcode == 3 || opcode == 4 || opcode == 5 || opcode == 6 || opcode == 7 || opcode == 8 ||
            opcode == 9 || opcode == 0xB || opcode == 0xC;
    }

    inline size_t parameter_size(uint8_t opcode, bool initializing)
    {
        switch (opcode)
        {
            case 2: return 7;
            case 3: return 30;
            case 4: return 10;
            case 5: return 20;
            // Execute scripts need only the activation byte; the native dispatcher supplies the workspace slot.
            case 6: return initializing ? 21 : 1;
            case 7: return initializing ? 32 : 1;
            case 8: return initializing ? 27 : 1;
            case 9: return initializing ? 11 : 1;
            case 0xB: return initializing ? 19 : 1;
            case 0xC: return initializing ? 10 : 1;
            default: return 0;
        }
    }

    inline float dot(const Vector& a, const Vector& b)
    {
        return a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2];
    }

    inline Vector normalize(Vector v)
    {
        const float length = std::sqrt(dot(v, v));
        if (length != 0)
            for (float& component : v) component /= length;
        return v;
    }

    inline void update_fade_color(State& state)
    {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) state.effect.color[i] = state.fade.value[i];
        state.effect.level = state.fade.value[3];
    }

    inline bool configure(State& state, uint8_t opcode, std::span<const uint8_t> params)
    {
        if (!handles(opcode) || params.empty()) return false;
        const bool direct = opcode == 2 || opcode == 3 || opcode == 4 || opcode == 5;
        const bool initializing = direct || params[0] == 0;
        if (params.size() < parameter_size(opcode, initializing)) return false;
        if (initializing && opcode == 0xB && read_s16(params, 8) == read_s16(params, 16)) return false;
        if (initializing && opcode == 0xB && (params[18] & 0xC) == 0xC) return false;
        if (initializing && opcode == 0xC && read_s16(params, 2) == 0 &&
            read_s16(params, 4) == 0 && read_s16(params, 6) == 0) return false;
        std::optional<gte::Plane> plane;
        if (initializing && opcode == 0xC)
        {
            plane = gte::make_plane({read_s16(params, 2), read_s16(params, 4), read_s16(params, 6)},
                read_s16(params, 8));
            if (!plane) return false;
        }
        if (!initializing)
        {
            if (params[0] != 1 || !state.initialized || state.opcode != opcode) return false;
            state.executing = true;
            return true;
        }

        state = {};
        state.opcode = opcode;
        state.initialized = true;
        state.executing = direct;
        auto& effect = state.effect;
        if (opcode == 2)
        {
            // AMBNT offsets polygon colors, rather than changing the ambient light.
            effect.kind = Kind::color_offset;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) effect.color[i] = read_s16(params, 2 * i);
            effect.flags = params[6];
        }
        else if (opcode == 3 || opcode == 7)
        {
            const size_t start = opcode == 3 ? 0 : 2;
            effect.kind = Kind::lighting;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
            {
                effect.color[i] = params[start + i];
                for (size_t j = 0; j < 3; ++j)
                {
                    effect.light_colors[i][j] = params[start + 3 + 3 * i + j];
                    effect.light_directions[i][j] = read_s16(params, start + 12 + 6 * i + 2 * j) / 4096.0f;
                }
            }
        }
        else if (opcode == 5)
        {
            effect.kind = Kind::positional_lighting;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
            {
                effect.light_position[i] = read_s16(params, 2 * i);
                effect.light_colors[0][i] = read_s16(params, 8 + 2 * i);
                effect.color[i] = read_s16(params, 14 + 2 * i);
            }
            effect.light_radius = read_s16(params, 6);
        }
        else if (opcode == 4 || opcode == 9)
        {
            effect.kind = Kind::below_level;
            if (opcode == 4)
            {
                for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) effect.color[i] = read_s16(params, 2 * i);
                effect.level = read_s16(params, 6);
                effect.flags = params[8];
            }
            else
            {
                effect.level = read_s16(params, 2);
                for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) effect.color[i] = read_s16(params, 4 + 2 * i);
                effect.flags = params[10];
            }
        }
        else if (opcode == 6 || opcode == 8)
        {
            effect.kind = opcode == 6 ? Kind::color_offset : Kind::below_level;
            effect.color_fade = opcode == 6;
            const size_t channels = opcode == 6 ? 3 : 4;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < channels; ++i)
            {
                state.fade.value[i] = read_s16(params, 2 + 2 * i);
                state.fade.target[i] = read_s16(params, 2 + 2 * channels + 2 * i);
                state.fade.step[i] = read_s16(params, 2 + 4 * channels + 2 * i);
                // PC LIGHT scripts can use positive steps toward negative targets.
                if (opcode == 6 && state.fade.target[i] < 0 && state.fade.step[i] > 0)
                    state.fade.step[i] = signed_word(-state.fade.step[i]);
            }
            effect.flags = params[2 + 6 * channels];
            update_fade_color(state);
        }
        else if (opcode == 0xB)
        {
            effect.kind = Kind::gradient;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
            {
                effect.color[i] = read_s16(params, 2 + 2 * i);
                effect.target_color[i] = read_s16(params, 10 + 2 * i);
            }
            effect.level = read_s16(params, 8);
            effect.target_level = read_s16(params, 16);
            effect.flags = params[18];
            if ((effect.flags & 0x18) == 0x18)
            {
                effect.level = signed_word(-static_cast<int>(effect.level));
                effect.target_level = signed_word(-static_cast<int>(effect.target_level));
            }
            effect.gradient_range = signed_word(static_cast<int>(effect.target_level - effect.level));
        }
        else
        {
            effect.kind = Kind::clip;
            effect.plane = *plane;
            effect.level = read_s16(params, 8);
        }
        return true;
    }

    inline void advance(State& state, int frame_multiplier)
    {
        if ((state.opcode != 6 && state.opcode != 8) || !state.executing || state.fade.finished) return;
        if (++state.fade.frame < std::max(frame_multiplier, 1)) return;
        state.fade.frame = 0;
        bool finished = true;
        const size_t channels = state.opcode == 6 ? 3 : 4;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < channels; ++i)
        {
            auto& value = state.fade.value[i];
            const int step = state.fade.step[i];
            value = signed_word(value + step);
            if ((step >= 0 && value >= state.fade.target[i]) || (step < 0 && value <= state.fade.target[i]))
                value = state.fade.target[i];
            else
                finished = false;
        }
        state.fade.finished = finished;
        update_fade_color(state);
    }

    inline float color_coordinate(const Effect& effect, const Vector& position)
    {
        const size_t axis = effect.kind == Kind::below_level ? ((effect.flags & 4) ? 1 : 2) :
            ((effect.flags & 0xC) == 4 ? 1 : ((effect.flags & 0xC) == 8 ? 2 : 0));
        float coordinate = position[axis];
        if (effect.kind == Kind::gradient && (effect.flags & 0x10) && axis != 0) coordinate = -coordinate;
        return coordinate;
    }

    inline Vector color_offset(const Effect& effect, const Vector& position)
    {
        if (effect.kind == Kind::color_offset) return effect.color;
        const float coordinate = color_coordinate(effect, position);
        if (effect.kind == Kind::below_level)
            return coordinate < effect.level ? effect.color : Vector{};
        if (coordinate >= effect.level) return {};
        const auto distance = static_cast<int64_t>(std::trunc(coordinate) - effect.level);
        const auto factor = gte::word(static_cast<int64_t>(gte::long_word(distance * 4096)) / effect.gradient_range);
        gte::Vector start{};
        gte::LongVector far_color{};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        {
            start[i] = gte::word(static_cast<int32_t>(effect.color[i]) * 16);
            far_color[i] = static_cast<int32_t>(effect.target_color[i]) * 16;
        }
        const auto interpolated = gte::interpolate(start, far_color, factor);
        Vector result{};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
            result[i] = interpolated[i] / 16.0f;
        return result;
    }

    inline uint32_t add_color(uint32_t color, const Vector& offset)
    {
        uint32_t result = color & 0xFF000000;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        {
            const size_t shift = 16 - 8 * i;
            const int component = static_cast<int>((color >> shift) & 255) + static_cast<int>(std::floor(offset[i]));
            result |= static_cast<uint32_t>(std::clamp(component, 0, 255)) << shift;
        }
        return result;
    }

    inline uint32_t apply_color_offset(const Effect& effect, const Vector& position,
        uint32_t current_color, uint32_t source_color)
    {
        if (effect.kind == Kind::gradient || ((effect.flags & 1) &&
            (effect.kind == Kind::color_offset || color_coordinate(effect, position) < effect.level)))
            current_color = (current_color & 0xFF000000) | (source_color & 0xFFFFFF);
        return add_color(current_color, color_offset(effect, position));
    }

    inline bool gpu_color_offset(const Effect& effect, bool enhanced_lighting)
    {
        return enhanced_lighting && effect.kind == Kind::color_offset;
    }

    inline bool post_lighting_color(const Effect& effect, bool enhanced_lighting)
    {
        return gpu_color_offset(effect, enhanced_lighting) && effect.color_fade;
    }

    inline std::array<float, 4> post_lighting_color_uniform(const Effect& effect, bool enhanced_lighting)
    {
        std::array<float, 4> result{};
        if (post_lighting_color(effect, enhanced_lighting))
        {
            for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) result[i] = std::floor(effect.color[i]) / 255.0f;
            result[3] = (result[0] != 0 || result[1] != 0 || result[2] != 0) ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
        }
        return result;
    }

    inline Vector triangle_average(const std::array<Vector, 3>& positions)
    {
        Vector average{};
        for (const auto& position : positions)
            for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) average[i] += std::trunc(position[i]);
        for (float& component : average) component = std::trunc(component / 3.0f);
        return average;
    }

    inline gte::Vector fixed_normal(const Vector& normal)
    {
        gte::Vector result{};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) result[i] = gte::word(std::llround(normal[i] * 4096));
        return result;
    }

    inline gte::Matrix light_directions(const Effect& effect)
    {
        gte::Matrix result{};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
            result[i] = fixed_normal(effect.light_directions[i]);
        return result;
    }

    inline uint32_t light_color(uint32_t color, const Effect& effect, const gte::Vector& normal,
        const gte::Matrix& directions)
    {
        gte::Matrix colors{};
        gte::LongVector background{};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        {
            background[i] = static_cast<int32_t>(effect.color[i] * 16);
            for (size_t j = 0; j < 3; ++j) colors[i][j] = gte::word(static_cast<int32_t>(effect.light_colors[j][i] * 16));
        }
        return gte::normal_color(color, directions, colors, background, normal);
    }

    inline uint32_t light_color(uint32_t color, const Effect& effect, const Vector& normal)
    {
        return light_color(color, effect, fixed_normal(normal), light_directions(effect));
    }

    inline uint32_t enhanced_light_color(uint32_t color, const Effect& effect, const Vector& normal)
    {
        Vector light = effect.color;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        {
            const float intensity = std::max(dot(normal, effect.light_directions[i]), 0.0f);
            for (size_t j = 0; j < 3; ++j) light[j] += intensity * effect.light_colors[i][j];
        }
        uint32_t result = color & 0xFF000000;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        {
            const size_t shift = 16 - 8 * i;
            const int component = static_cast<int>(((color >> shift) & 255) * std::clamp(light[i], 0.0f, 2047.0f) / 128.0f);
            result |= static_cast<uint32_t>(std::clamp(component, 0, 255)) << shift;
        }
        return result;
    }

    inline bool project_to_plane(Vector& position, const Effect& effect)
    {
        gte::Vector vertex{};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) vertex[i] = gte::word(static_cast<int32_t>(position[i]));
        auto projected = gte::transform_ir(gte::to_plane(effect.plane, {}), vertex);
        const bool visible = gte::project(projected, effect.plane);
        const auto world = gte::transform(gte::from_plane(effect.plane, {}), projected);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) position[i] = static_cast<float>(world[i]);
        return visible;
    }
}
```

```cpp
            p_hundred *left_eye_tex;
            p_hundred *right_eye_tex;

    void ff7_field_initialize_eyetx()
    {
        for (auto &custom : ff7_model_data)
        {
            custom.current_mouth_idx = 0;
            custom.mouth_tex = nullptr;
        }
    }

    void ff7_field_reset_blink_frames()
    {
        blink_frames.fill(BLINKING_FRAMES);
    }

    void ff7_field_set_mouth_index(byte model_id, byte mouth_index)
    {
        if (model_id >= FF7_MAX_NUM_MODEL_ENTITIES)
        {
            ffnx_error("subcode[EYETX]: Invalid model ID %u for mouth index\n", model_id);
            return;
        }
        ff7_model_data[model_id].current_mouth_idx = mouth_index;
    }

    namespace
    {
        struct facial_texture
        {
            std::string filename;
            p_hundred *texture = nullptr;
            bool custom_found = false;
        };

        struct facial_texture_cache
        {
            bool initialized = false;
            bool valid = false;
            bool has_eyes = false;
            bool eyes_selected = false;
            bool is_npc = false;
            byte eye_index = MAXBYTE;
            const field_animation_data *animation = nullptr;
            const ff7_hrc_polygon_data *frame_object = nullptr;
            p_hundred *native_left_eye = nullptr;
            p_hundred *native_right_eye = nullptr;
            const polygon_data *facial_polygon = nullptr;
            std::array<const indexed_primitive *, 3> facial_primitives{};
            std::string directory;
            std::string model_filename;
            std::string model_name;
            std::string default_left_filename;
            std::string default_right_filename;
            std::string left_basename;
            std::string right_basename;
            std::string left_extension;
            std::string right_extension = ".TEX";
            std::string mouth_basename;
            std::unordered_map<byte, facial_texture> left_eyes;
            std::unordered_map<byte, facial_texture> right_eyes;
            std::unordered_map<int, facial_texture> mouths;
            std::unordered_map<std::string, p_hundred *> owned_textures;
        };

        std::array<facial_texture_cache, FF7_MAX_NUM_MODEL_ENTITIES> facial_textures;
        bool facial_field_initialized = false;
        WORD facial_field_id = 0;
        std::string facial_basedir;
        std::string facial_direct_path;
        std::string facial_directory;

        void clear_facial_textures(int model_id)
        {
            auto &custom = ff7_model_data[model_id];
            custom.left_eye_tex = nullptr;
            custom.right_eye_tex = nullptr;
            custom.mouth_tex = nullptr;
            custom.has_mouth = 0;

            auto &cache = facial_textures[model_id];
            for (const auto &[filename, texture] : cache.owned_textures)
                if (texture) ff7_externals.field_unload_model_tex(texture);
            cache = {};
        }

        void ensure_facial_texture_field()
        {
            if (facial_field_initialized && facial_field_id == *common_externals.current_field_id &&
                facial_basedir == basedir && facial_direct_path == direct_mode_path)
                return;

            // Path changes are handled per model when rebound, so other live overrides stay valid.
            if (!facial_field_initialized || facial_field_id != *common_externals.current_field_id)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < FF7_MAX_NUM_MODEL_ENTITIES; ++i)
                    clear_facial_textures(i);
            }

            facial_field_initialized = true;
            facial_field_id = *common_externals.current_field_id;
            facial_basedir = basedir;
            facial_direct_path = direct_mode_path;
            facial_directory = facial_basedir + "/" + facial_direct_path + "/flevel/";
        }

        bool split_facial_filename(const char *path, std::string &basename, std::string &extension)
        {
            char name[_MAX_FNAME];
            char ext[_MAX_EXT];
            if (_splitpath_s(path, nullptr, 0, nullptr, 0, name, sizeof(name), ext, sizeof(ext)))
            {
                ffnx_error("subcode[EYETX]: Invalid facial texture filename: %s\n", path);
                return false;
            }
            basename = name;
            extension = ext;
            return true;
        }

        facial_texture_cache &get_facial_texture_cache(int model_id, field_animation_data *animation)
        {
            auto &cache = facial_textures[model_id];
            const char *model_filename = (const char *)(*ff7_externals.field_models_data + 10380 * model_id + 512);
            const auto &defaults = ff7_externals.field_models_eye_blink_buffer[animation->eye_texture_idx == 9 ? 0 : animation->eye_texture_idx];
            const char *left_filename = defaults.static_left_eye_filename ? defaults.static_left_eye_filename : "";
            const char *right_filename = defaults.static_right_eye_filename ? defaults.static_right_eye_filename : "";

            if (cache.initialized && cache.animation == animation && cache.frame_object == animation->anim_frame_object &&
                cache.native_left_eye == animation->static_left_eye_tex && cache.native_right_eye == animation->static_right_eye_tex &&
                cache.directory == facial_directory && cache.model_filename == model_filename && cache.eye_index == animation->eye_texture_idx &&
                cache.has_eyes == !!defaults.has_eyes &&
                cache.default_left_filename == left_filename && cache.default_right_filename == right_filename)
                return cache;

            clear_facial_textures(model_id);
            cache.initialized = true;
            cache.animation = animation;
            cache.frame_object = animation->anim_frame_object;
            cache.native_left_eye = animation->static_left_eye_tex;
            cache.native_right_eye = animation->static_right_eye_tex;
            cache.directory = facial_directory;
            cache.model_filename = model_filename;
            cache.eye_index = animation->eye_texture_idx;
            cache.has_eyes = !!defaults.has_eyes;
            cache.is_npc = cache.eye_index == 9;
            cache.default_left_filename = left_filename;
            cache.default_right_filename = right_filename;

            std::string extension;
            if (!split_facial_filename(model_filename, cache.model_name, extension))
                return cache;
            if (cache.has_eyes && (!*left_filename || !*right_filename))
            {
                ffnx_error("subcode[EYETX]: Missing default eye filenames for model %s\n", cache.model_name.c_str());
                return cache;
            }
            if (*left_filename && !split_facial_filename(left_filename, cache.left_basename, cache.left_extension))
                return cache;
            if (*right_filename && !split_facial_filename(right_filename, cache.right_basename, cache.right_extension))
                return cache;
            cache.mouth_basename = cache.is_npc ? "npc" : cache.right_basename.substr(0, cache.right_basename.find('_'));
            cache.valid = true;
            return cache;
        }

        bool facial_texture_exists(const std::string &basename, const char *part, bool trace_missing)
        {
            const std::string path = facial_directory + basename + ".TEX";
            const bool found = fileExists(path.c_str());
            if (!found && trace_missing && (trace_all || trace_direct || trace_opcodes))
                ffnx_trace("subcode[EYETX]: Custom %s texture not found: %s\n", part, path.c_str());
            return found;
        }

        p_hundred *load_facial_texture(facial_texture_cache &cache, std::string &filename, bool eye)
        {
            auto [entry, inserted] = cache.owned_textures.try_emplace(filename, nullptr);
            if (!inserted) return entry->second;

            if (eye)
            {
                // Native field teardown owns the original eyes, not these cached expressions.
                ff7_model_eye_texture_data eye_data{};
                field_animation_data temporary_animation{};
                eye_data.has_eyes = 1;
                eye_data.static_left_eye_filename = filename.data();
                ff7_externals.field_load_model_eye_tex(&eye_data, &temporary_animation);
                entry->second = temporary_animation.static_left_eye_tex;
            }
            else
            {
                struc_3 info;
                ff7_externals.create_struc_3_info_sub_67455E(&info);
                info.base_directory = (uint32_t)ff7_externals.field_unk_909288;
                info.file_context.use_lgp = 1;
                info.file_context.lgp_num = 1;
                info.file_context.name_mangler = 0;
                entry->second = ff7_externals.field_load_model_tex(0, 0, filename.data(), &info, common_externals.get_game_object());
            }
            if (!entry->second)
                ffnx_error("subcode[EYETX]: Could not load facial texture: %s\n", filename.c_str());
            return entry->second;
        }

        const facial_texture &get_facial_eye(facial_texture_cache &cache, byte index, bool right)
        {
            auto &eyes = right ? cache.right_eyes : cache.left_eyes;
            auto [entry, inserted] = eyes.try_emplace(index);
            auto &selection = entry->second;
            if (!inserted) return selection;

            const char *part = right ? "right eye" : "left eye";
            const auto &basename = right ? cache.right_basename : cache.left_basename;
            const auto &extension = right ? cache.right_extension : cache.left_extension;
            std::string candidate = "eye_" + cache.model_name + (right ? "r_" : "_") + std::to_string(index);
            selection.custom_found = facial_texture_exists(candidate, part, index > 2);
            if (!selection.custom_found)
            {
                candidate = (cache.is_npc ? (right ? "npc_eye2r" : "npc_eye2") : basename) + std::string("_") + std::to_string(index);
                selection.custom_found = facial_texture_exists(candidate, part, index > 2);
            }
            selection.filename = (selection.custom_found ? candidate : basename) + extension;
            p_hundred *native_eye = right ? cache.native_right_eye : cache.native_left_eye;
            if (!selection.custom_found && !cache.is_npc && native_eye)
                selection.texture = native_eye;
            else
                selection.texture = load_facial_texture(cache, selection.filename, true);
            return selection;
        }

        const facial_texture &get_facial_mouth(facial_texture_cache &cache, int index)
        {
            auto [entry, inserted] = cache.mouths.try_emplace(index);
            auto &selection = entry->second;
            if (!inserted) return selection;

            std::string candidate = "mouth_" + cache.model_name + "_" + std::to_string(index);
            selection.custom_found = facial_texture_exists(candidate, "mouth", index > 0);
            if (!selection.custom_found && !cache.mouth_basename.empty())
            {
                candidate = cache.mouth_basename + "_mouth_" + std::to_string(index);
                selection.custom_found = facial_texture_exists(candidate, "mouth", index > 0);
            }
            if (selection.custom_found)
            {
                selection.filename = candidate + cache.right_extension;
                selection.texture = load_facial_texture(cache, selection.filename, false);
            }
            return selection;
        }
    }

    void ff7_handle_KAWAI_reset()
    {
        static WORD last_field_id = 0;

        if (last_field_id != *common_externals.current_field_id)
        {
            last_field_id = *common_externals.current_field_id;
            reset_kawai_effects();
            ensure_facial_texture_field();

            // Reset eyes blinking
            ff7_externals.field_model_blink_data_D000C8->blink_left_eye_mode = 0;
            ff7_externals.field_model_blink_data_D000C8->blink_right_eye_mode = 0;

            for(int i = 0; i < FF7_MAX_NUM_MODEL_ENTITIES; i++)
            {
                // Reset mouths
                ff7_model_data[i].current_mouth_idx = 0;
                ff7_model_data[i].mouth_tex = nullptr;
                ff7_model_data[i].has_mouth = 0;
            }
        }
    }

    bool ff7_field_is_facial_primitive(const polygon_data *polygon, const indexed_primitive *primitive)
    {
        if (getmode_cached()->driver_mode != MODE_FIELD || !polygon || !primitive) return false;
        for (const auto &cache : facial_textures)
            if (cache.facial_polygon == polygon)
                for (const auto *facial_primitive : cache.facial_primitives)
                    if (facial_primitive == primitive) return true;
        return false;
    }

    int ff7_internal_blink_eye(field_animation_data *field_anim_data, field_model_blink_data *blink_data)
    {
        int i;
        ff7_polygon_set *polygon_set = nullptr;
        struct hrc_bone *bones;
        hrc_data *hrc_data;
        int blink_left_eye_mode;
        int blink_right_eye_mode;
        const bool cached_eyes = ff7_advanced_blinking && facial_textures[blink_data->model_id].eyes_selected;
        p_hundred *left_eye = cached_eyes ? ff7_model_data[blink_data->model_id].left_eye_tex : field_anim_data->static_left_eye_tex;
        p_hundred *right_eye = cached_eyes ? ff7_model_data[blink_data->model_id].right_eye_tex : field_anim_data->static_right_eye_tex;
        auto &cache = facial_textures[blink_data->model_id];
        cache.facial_polygon = nullptr;
        cache.facial_primitives = {};

        if ( field_anim_data->anim_frame_object )
        {
            hrc_data = field_anim_data->anim_frame_object->hrc_data;
            if ( hrc_data )
            {
                int bone_idx = 0;
                bones = field_anim_data->anim_frame_object->hrc_data->bones;
                if ( (char)field_anim_data->eye_texture_idx >= 33 )
                    return 1;
                while ( bone_idx < (signed int)hrc_data->num_bones && _strcmpi(bones->bone_name, "head") )
                {
                    ++bone_idx;
                    ++bones;
                }
                if ( bone_idx == hrc_data->num_bones ) return 0;
                polygon_set = bones->rsd_array->rsd_data->polygon_set;
                ff7_externals.field_sub_6A2736(polygon_set);
                // Mouth replacement logic
                if (ff7_advanced_blinking && polygon_set && polygon_set->numgroups > 3 && ff7_model_data[blink_data->model_id].mouth_tex)
                {
                    if (polygon_set->hundred_data_group_array[3] != NULL)
                    {
                        polygon_set->hundred_data_group_array[3] = ff7_model_data[blink_data->model_id].mouth_tex;
                        polygon_set->per_group_hundreds = 1;
                    }
                }
                blink_left_eye_mode = blink_data->blink_left_eye_mode;
                for ( i = 0; i < (signed int)polygon_set->numgroups && !polygon_set->hundred_data[i].texture_set; ++i );
                if ( i == polygon_set->numgroups )return 0;
                if (polygon_set->indexed_primitives)
                {
                    // Use the blink and mouth replacement groups, not all textured head polygons.
                    cache.facial_polygon = polygon_set->polygon_data;
                    cache.facial_primitives[0] = polygon_set->indexed_primitives[i];
                    if (i + 1 < polygon_set->numgroups)
                        cache.facial_primitives[1] = polygon_set->indexed_primitives[i + 1];
                    if (polygon_set->numgroups > 3 && (polygon_set->hundred_data[3].texture_set ||
                        (ff7_advanced_blinking && ff7_model_data[blink_data->model_id].mouth_tex)))
                        cache.facial_primitives[2] = polygon_set->indexed_primitives[3];
                }
                if ( blink_left_eye_mode == 1 )
                {
                    if (ff7_advanced_blinking && polygon_set->numgroups > 1 && ff7_model_data[blink_data->model_id].left_eye_tex) polygon_set->hundred_data_group_array[1] = ff7_model_data[blink_data->model_id].left_eye_tex;
                    ff7_externals.field_sub_6A2782(i, &polygon_set->hundred_data[i], polygon_set);
                }
                else
                {
                    if ( blink_left_eye_mode != 2 )
                    {
                        if (ff7_advanced_blinking && !ff7_model_data[blink_data->model_id].has_mouth) polygon_set->per_group_hundreds = 0;
                        return 0;
                    }
                    polygon_set->per_group_hundreds = 1;
                    if ( !left_eye )
                    goto LABEL_22;
                    ff7_externals.field_sub_6A2782(i, left_eye, polygon_set);
                }
                blink_right_eye_mode = blink_data->blink_right_eye_mode;
                if ( ++i == polygon_set->numgroups ) return 0;
                if ( blink_right_eye_mode == 1 )
                {
                    if (ff7_advanced_blinking && polygon_set->numgroups > 2 && ff7_model_data[blink_data->model_id].right_eye_tex) polygon_set->hundred_data_group_array[2] = ff7_model_data[blink_data->model_id].right_eye_tex;
                    ff7_externals.field_sub_6A2782(i, &polygon_set->hundred_data[i], polygon_set);
                    return 1;
                }
                if ( blink_right_eye_mode != 2 )
                {
                    if (ff7_advanced_blinking && !ff7_model_data[blink_data->model_id].has_mouth) polygon_set->per_group_hundreds = 0;
                    return 0;
                }
                polygon_set->per_group_hundreds = 1;
                if ( right_eye )
                {
                    ff7_externals.field_sub_6A2782(i, right_eye, polygon_set);
                    return 1;
                }
            LABEL_22:
                ff7_externals.field_sub_6A2782(i, &polygon_set->hundred_data[i], polygon_set);
                return 0;
            }
        }

        return 0;
    }

    int ff7_field_blink_eye_sub_649B50(field_animation_data *field_anim_data, field_model_blink_data *blink_data)
    {
        const byte model_id = blink_data->model_id;
        if (model_id >= FF7_MAX_NUM_MODEL_ENTITIES)
        {
            ffnx_error("field_blink_eye_sub: Invalid model ID %u\n", model_id);
            return 0;
        }

        // A synchronous EYETX callback can run before the regular field reset.
        ensure_facial_texture_field();
        if (ff7_advanced_blinking)
        {
            if (field_anim_data->eye_texture_idx < 10)
            {
                auto &cache = get_facial_texture_cache(model_id, field_anim_data);
                auto &custom = ff7_model_data[model_id];
                const byte left_index = blink_data->blink_left_eye_mode;
                const byte right_index = blink_data->blink_right_eye_mode;
                const int mouth_index = custom.current_mouth_idx;

                if (trace_all || trace_opcodes)
                    ffnx_trace("field_blink_eye_sub: curr_entity_id=%u,curr_model_id=%u,curr_eye_index=%u,curr_mouth_index=%u,curr_model_name=%s\n",
                        *ff7_externals.current_entity_id, model_id, field_anim_data->eye_texture_idx, mouth_index, cache.model_name.c_str());

                if (cache.valid)
                {
                    bool left_found = false, right_found = false;
                    if (cache.has_eyes)
                    {
                        const auto &left = get_facial_eye(cache, left_index, false);
                        const auto &right = get_facial_eye(cache, right_index, true);
                        left_found = left.custom_found;
                        right_found = right.custom_found;
                        custom.left_eye_tex = left.texture;
                        custom.right_eye_tex = right.texture;
                        cache.eyes_selected = true;
                    }
                    const auto &mouth = get_facial_mouth(cache, mouth_index);
                    custom.mouth_tex = mouth.texture;
                    custom.has_mouth = mouth.texture != nullptr;

                    // Keep native modes for mixed requests; extended expressions use the closed-eye path.
                    if (left_index > 2 && right_index > 2 && (left_found || right_found))
                    {
                        blink_data->blink_left_eye_mode = 2;
                        blink_data->blink_right_eye_mode = 2;
                    }
                }
            }
            else if (facial_textures[model_id].initialized)
                clear_facial_textures(model_id);
        }

        // Original code
        int ret = ff7_internal_blink_eye(field_anim_data, blink_data);

        // 60FPS patch: wait time and blink time
        if(ff7_fps_limiter == FPS_LIMITER_60FPS)
        {
            if(blink_data->blink_left_eye_mode == 2 && blink_data->blink_right_eye_mode == 2)
            {
                auto &field_event_data = (*ff7_externals.field_event_data_ptr)[blink_data->model_id];
                if(blink_frames[blink_data->model_id] > 0)
                {
                    field_event_data.blink_wait_frames = 0;
                    blink_frames[blink_data->model_id]--;
                }
                else
                {
                    field_event_data.blink_wait_frames = 64 * common_frame_multiplier + getRandomInt(0, 32 * common_frame_multiplier);
                    blink_frames[blink_data->model_id] = BLINKING_FRAMES;
                }
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }

    int ff7_field_models_eye_to_model(char* model_name)
    {
        // Cloud
        if ( !_strcmpi(model_name, "AAAA") )

        if ( !_strcmpi(model_name, "AGGB") )

        if ( !_strcmpi(model_name, "AHDF") )
            return 7;

        // Cait Sith
        if ( !_strcmpi(model_name, "AEBC") )
            return 8;

        return 9; // Defaults to Cloud eye
    }
```

`src/ff7/field/kawai_gte.h`:

```h
/****************************************************************************/
//    Copyright (C) 2009 Aali132                                            //
//    Copyright (C) 2018 quantumpencil                                      //
//    Copyright (C) 2018 Maxime Bacoux                                      //
//    Copyright (C) 2020 myst6re                                            //
//    Copyright (C) 2020 Chris Rizzitello                                   //
//    Copyright (C) 2020 John Pritchard                                     //
//    Copyright (C) 2026 Julian Xhokaxhiu                                   //
//                                                                          //
//    This file is part of FFNx                                             //
//                                                                          //
//    FFNx is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify          //
//    it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by  //
//    the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License         //
//                                                                          //
//    FFNx is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,               //
//    but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of        //
//    MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.  See the         //
//    GNU General Public License for more details.                          //
/****************************************************************************/

#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <bit>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <optional>

namespace ff7::field::kawai::gte
{
    using Vector = std::array<int16_t, 3>;
    using LongVector = std::array<int32_t, 3>;
    using Matrix = std::array<Vector, 3>;

    struct Affine
    {
        Matrix rotation = {{{4096, 0, 0}, {0, 4096, 0}, {0, 0, 4096}}};
        LongVector translation{};
    };

    struct Plane
    {
        Vector normal{};
        Vector anchor{};
        Matrix rotation{};
    };

    constexpr int16_t word(int64_t value)
    {
        return std::bit_cast<int16_t>(static_cast<uint16_t>(value));
    }

    constexpr int32_t long_word(int64_t value)
    {
        return std::bit_cast<int32_t>(static_cast<uint32_t>(value));
    }

    constexpr int64_t mac44(int64_t value)
    {
        const uint64_t bits = static_cast<uint64_t>(value) & ((uint64_t{1} << 44) - 1);
        return (bits & (uint64_t{1} << 43)) ? static_cast<int64_t>(bits) - (int64_t{1} << 44) :
            static_cast<int64_t>(bits);
    }

    constexpr int16_t ir(int64_t value, bool positive = false)
    {
        return static_cast<int16_t>(std::clamp<int64_t>(value, positive ? 0 : -32768, 32767));
    }

    constexpr uint32_t integer_sqrt(uint32_t value)
    {
        uint32_t result = 0;
        for (uint32_t bit = uint32_t{1} << 30; bit != 0; bit >>= 2)
        {
            if (value >= result + bit)
            {
                value -= result + bit;
                result = (result >> 1) + bit;
            }
            else result >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    // These formulas reproduce all 192 entries of the USA PsyQ SQRT/rsqrt tables
    // at 8004B668/8004B7FC, including the table-index quantization.
    constexpr std::optional<int32_t> square_root(uint32_t value)
    {
        if (value > 0x7FFFFFFF) return std::nullopt;
        if (value == 0) return 0;
        const int leading = std::countl_zero(value) & ~1;
        const uint32_t normalized = leading >= 24 ? value << (leading - 24) : value >> (24 - leading);
        const uint32_t table = integer_sqrt(normalized << 18);
        return static_cast<int32_t>((table << ((31 - leading) / 2)) >> 12);
    }

    constexpr std::optional<Vector> normalize(const Vector& vector)
    {
        uint32_t squared = 0;
        for (int32_t component : vector) squared += static_cast<uint32_t>(component * component);
        if (squared > 0x7FFFFFFF) return std::nullopt;
        if (squared == 0) return Vector{};
        const int leading = std::countl_zero(squared) & ~1;
        const uint32_t normalized = leading >= 24 ? squared << (leading - 24) : squared >> (24 - leading);
        const int32_t factor = static_cast<int32_t>(integer_sqrt((uint32_t{1} << 30) / normalized));
        Vector result{};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
            result[i] = word((static_cast<int32_t>(vector[i]) * factor) >> ((31 - leading) / 2));
        return result;
    }

    constexpr LongVector transform(const Affine& matrix, const Vector& vector)
    {
        LongVector result{};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        {
            int64_t accumulator = mac44(static_cast<int64_t>(matrix.translation[i]) * 4096);
            for (size_t j = 0; j < 3; ++j)
                accumulator = mac44(accumulator + static_cast<int32_t>(matrix.rotation[i][j]) * vector[j]);
            result[i] = long_word(accumulator >> 12);
        }
        return result;
    }

    constexpr Vector transform_ir(const Affine& matrix, const Vector& vector, bool positive = false)
    {
        const auto values = transform(matrix, vector);
        return {ir(values[0], positive), ir(values[1], positive), ir(values[2], positive)};
    }

    constexpr LongVector transform_world(const Affine& matrix, const LongVector& vector)
    {
        LongVector result{};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        {
            int64_t accumulator = mac44(static_cast<int64_t>(matrix.translation[i]) * 4096);
            for (size_t j = 0; j < 3; ++j)
                accumulator = mac44(accumulator + static_cast<int64_t>(matrix.rotation[i][j]) * vector[j]);
            result[i] = long_word(accumulator >> 12);
        }
        return result;
    }

    constexpr Matrix transpose(const Matrix& matrix)
    {
        Matrix result{};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
            for (size_t j = 0; j < 3; ++j) result[i][j] = matrix[j][i];
        return result;
    }

    constexpr Affine compose(const Affine& left, const Affine& right)
    {
        Affine result;
        const Affine rotation = {left.rotation, {}};
        for (size_t column = 0; column < 3; ++column)
        {
            const auto values = transform_ir(rotation,
                {right.rotation[0][column], right.rotation[1][column], right.rotation[2][column]});
            for (size_t row = 0; row < 3; ++row) result.rotation[row][column] = values[row];
        }
        const auto translation = transform_ir(left,
            {word(right.translation[0]), word(right.translation[1]), word(right.translation[2])});
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) result.translation[i] = translation[i];
        return result;
    }

    // INTPL (980011), then its saturated IR values become GPL0's MAC base.
    // MTC2 sign-extends IR0; it does not clamp the interpolation factor to 0..4096.
    constexpr Vector interpolate(const Vector& start, const LongVector& far_color, int16_t factor)
    {
        Vector result{};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        {
            const int64_t base = static_cast<int64_t>(start[i]) * 4096;
            const auto difference = ir((static_cast<int64_t>(far_color[i]) * 4096 - base) >> 12);
            result[i] = ir((base + static_cast<int32_t>(factor) * difference) >> 12);
        }
        return result;
    }

    constexpr uint32_t normal_color(uint32_t color, const Matrix& directions, const Matrix& colors,
        const LongVector& background, const Vector& normal)
    {
        const auto light = transform_ir({directions, {}}, normal, true);
        const auto illumination = transform_ir({colors, background}, light, true);
        uint32_t result = color & 0xFF000000;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        {
            const size_t shift = 16 - 8 * i;
            const int32_t mac = (static_cast<int32_t>((color >> shift) & 255) * 16 * illumination[i]) >> 12;
            result |= static_cast<uint32_t>(std::clamp(mac >> 4, 0, 255)) << shift;
        }
        return result;
    }

    constexpr std::optional<Plane> make_plane(const Vector& normal, int16_t distance)
    {
        const auto unit = normalize(normal);
        if (!unit || *unit == Vector{}) return std::nullopt;
        Plane plane;
        plane.normal = *unit;
        const size_t component = (*unit)[2] ? 2 : ((*unit)[1] ? 1 : 0);
        plane.anchor[component] = word(static_cast<int32_t>(distance) * 4096 / (*unit)[component]);
        const Vector axis = {(*unit)[1], word(-(*unit)[0]), 0};
        const auto unit_axis = normalize(axis);
        const auto sine = square_root(static_cast<uint32_t>(axis[0] * axis[0] + axis[1] * axis[1]));
        if (!unit_axis || !sine) return std::nullopt;
        if (*unit_axis == Vector{})
        {
            plane.rotation = Affine{}.rotation;
            return plane;
        }
        const int32_t x = (*unit_axis)[0], y = (*unit_axis)[1], z = (*unit_axis)[2];
        const int32_t cosine = (*unit)[2], complement = 4096 - cosine;
        const int32_t xx = x * x, yy = y * y, zz = z * z, xy = x * y, xz = x * z, yz = y * z;
        const int32_t xs = x * *sine, ys = y * *sine, zs = z * *sine;
        plane.rotation = {{
            {word((xx + cosine * ((4096 * 4096 - xx) / 4096)) / 4096),
                word(((xy / 4096) * complement - zs) / 4096), word(((xz / 4096) * complement + ys) / 4096)},
            {word(((xy / 4096) * complement + zs) / 4096),
                word((yy + cosine * ((4096 * 4096 - yy) / 4096)) / 4096), word(((yz / 4096) * complement - xs) / 4096)},
            {word(((xz / 4096) * complement - ys) / 4096), word(((yz / 4096) * complement + xs) / 4096),
                word((zz + cosine * ((4096 * 4096 - zz) / 4096)) / 4096)}
        }};
        return plane;
    }

    constexpr Affine to_plane(const Plane& plane, const Affine& model)
    {
        Affine translation;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) translation.translation[i] = -plane.anchor[i];
        return compose({plane.rotation, {}}, compose(translation, model));
    }

    constexpr Affine from_plane(const Plane& plane, const Affine& camera)
    {
        Affine translation;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) translation.translation[i] = plane.anchor[i];
        return compose(compose(camera, translation), {transpose(plane.rotation), {}});
    }

    constexpr bool project(Vector& position, const Plane& plane)
    {
        const bool reverse = plane.normal == Vector{0, 0, -4096};
        const bool visible = reverse ? position[2] < 0 : position[2] > 0;
        if (!visible) position[2] = 0;
        return visible;
    }

    constexpr std::optional<Vector> point_direction(const Vector& light, int16_t radius,
        const LongVector& position, const Matrix& rotation)
    {
        if (radius == 0) return std::nullopt;
        LongVector delta{};
        uint32_t squared = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        {
            delta[i] = long_word(static_cast<int64_t>(light[i]) - position[i]);
            squared += static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<int64_t>(delta[i]) * delta[i]);
        }
        const auto root = square_root(squared);
        if (!root) return std::nullopt;
        const int32_t distance = *root + 2;
        const int32_t attenuation = long_word(static_cast<int64_t>(std::max<int32_t>(radius - distance, 0)) * 4096) / radius;
        Vector direction{};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        {
            const auto component = word(long_word(static_cast<int64_t>(delta[i]) * 4096) / distance);
            direction[i] = word((static_cast<int32_t>(component) * word(attenuation)) >> 12);
        }
        return transform_ir({transpose(rotation), {}}, direction);
    }
}
```
