```cpp
	return ((int(*)(int,int,int))ff8_externals.chara_one_seek_file)(fd, pos, whence);
}

int ff8_field_chara_one_read_model(int fd, uint8_t *const data, size_t size)
{
	int read = ((int(*)(int,uint8_t*const,size_t))ff8_externals.chara_one_read_file)(fd, data, size);

	if (trace_all || trace_vram) ffnx_trace("%s: size=%d\n", __func__, size);

	if (chara_one_models.contains(chara_one_current_pos)) {
		chara_one_models[chara_one_current_pos].isDirect = ff8_is_direct_file(fd);

		if (save_textures) {
			char filename[MAX_PATH];
			snprintf(filename, sizeof(filename), "field/model/second_chr");
			ff8_chara_one_model_save_textures(chara_one_models[chara_one_current_pos], data, filename);
		}

		chara_one_loaded_models.push_back(chara_one_current_pos);
	}

	return read;
}

int ff8_field_chara_one_read_mch(int fd, uint8_t *const data, size_t size)
{
	int read = ((int(*)(int,uint8_t*const,size_t))ff8_externals.chara_one_read_file)(fd, data, size);

	if (trace_all || trace_vram) ffnx_trace("%s: size=%d\n", __func__, size);

	int id = 0;
	for (uint32_t addr: chara_one_loaded_models) {
		if (chara_one_models[addr].isMch) {
			if (id == chara_one_current_mch) {
				chara_one_models[addr].isDirect = ff8_is_direct_file(fd);
				ff8_mch_parse_model(chara_one_models[addr], data, size);
				if (save_textures) {
					char filename[MAX_PATH];
					snprintf(filename, sizeof(filename), "field/model/main_chr");
					ff8_chara_one_model_save_textures(chara_one_models[addr], data, filename);
				}

				break;
			}
			++id;
		}
	}

	++chara_one_current_mch;

	return read;
}

int ff8_field_texture_upload_one(char *image_buffer, char bpp, char a3, int x, int16_t y, int w, int16_t h)
{
	if (trace_all || trace_vram) ffnx_trace("%s bpp=%d a3=%d image_buffer=0x%X\n", __func__, bpp, a3, image_buffer);

	while (chara_one_current_model < chara_one_loaded_models.size()) {
		CharaOneModel model = chara_one_models[chara_one_loaded_models.at(chara_one_current_model)];

		if (chara_one_current_texture < model.texturesData.size()) {
			next_rgba_modifier = model.rgbaModifier;
			next_bpp = Tim::Bpp(bpp);
			if (!model.isDirect && !is_remastered_hd_textures_disabled("field")) {
				snprintf(next_remastered_texture_name, MAX_PATH, "field.fs\\field_hd_new\\%s_%d", model.name, chara_one_current_texture);
			} else {
				next_remastered_texture_name[0] = '\0';
			}
			snprintf(next_texture_name, MAX_PATH, "field/model/%s_chr/%s-%d", model.isMch ? "main" : "second", model.name, chara_one_current_texture);

			++chara_one_current_texture;
			break;
		}

		++chara_one_current_model;
		chara_one_current_texture = 0;
	}

	return ((int(*)(char*,char,char,int,int16_t,int,int16_t))ff8_externals.chara_one_upload_texture)(image_buffer, bpp, a3, x, y, w, h);
}

void ff8_field_effects_upload_vram1(int16_t *pos_and_size, uint8_t *texture_buffer)
{
	Tim::Bpp bpp = Tim::Bpp4;
	char texture_name[MAX_PATH];

	snprintf(texture_name, sizeof(texture_name), "field/mapdata/%s/%s_pmp", get_current_field_name(), get_current_field_name());

	if (save_textures) {
		ff8_tim t = ff8_tim();
		t.pal_data = (uint16_t*)(texture_buffer - 512);
		t.pal_w = 256;
		t.pal_h = 1;
		t.img_data = texture_buffer;
		t.img_w = pos_and_size[2];
		t.img_h = pos_and_size[3] * 2; // This upload and the next one together
		Tim(bpp, t).save(texture_name);
	}

	ff8_upload_vram(pos_and_size, texture_buffer);

	// This upload and the next one together
	texturePacker.setTexture(texture_name, nullptr, TexturePacker::TextureInfos(pos_and_size[0], pos_and_size[1], pos_and_size[2], pos_and_size[3] * 2, bpp));
}

int battle_get_texture_file_name_index(void *texture_buffer)
{
	for (int i = 0; i < battle_texture_data_list_size; ++i) {
		if (battle_texture_data_list.at(i).data == texture_buffer) {
			return i;
		}
	}

	return -1;
}
static constexpr uint16_t GILGAMESH_FIRST_EFFECT_ID = FF8BattleEffect::GilgameshZantetsukenReverse;
static constexpr uint16_t GILGAMESH_LAST_EFFECT_ID = FF8BattleEffect::GilgameshExcalipoor;
static constexpr int GILGAMESH_G_FILE_ID = 751;

int16_t ff8_battle_open_and_read_file(int fileId, void *data, int a3, int callback)
{
	if (trace_all || trace_files) ffnx_trace("%s: %d => %s\n", __func__, fileId, ff8_externals.battle_filenames[fileId]);

	battle_texture_id = 0;
	battle_file_id = fileId;
	if (stricmp(ff8_externals.battle_filenames[fileId], "B0WAVE.DAT") == 0) {
		// Fix redundant texture
		strncpy(battle_texture_name, "battle/A8DEF.TIM", sizeof(battle_texture_name));

		if (trace_all || trace_vram) ffnx_trace("%s: rename texture to %s\n", __func__, battle_texture_name);
	} else {
		snprintf(battle_texture_name, sizeof(battle_texture_name), "battle/%s", ff8_externals.battle_filenames[fileId]);
	}

	// Remember texture name for later
	BattleTextureFileName tex = BattleTextureFileName();
	strncpy(tex.file_name, battle_texture_name, sizeof(tex.file_name));
	tex.data = data;

	int index = battle_get_texture_file_name_index(data);
	if (index < 0) {
		battle_texture_data_list[battle_texture_data_list_cursor] = tex;

		battle_texture_data_list_cursor = (battle_texture_data_list_cursor + 1) % battle_texture_data_list_size;
	} else {
		if (trace_all || trace_vram) ffnx_trace("%s: texture found in the list at index %d\n", __func__, index);

		battle_texture_data_list[index] = tex;
	}

	int16_t ret = ((int16_t(*)(int,void*,int,int))ff8_externals.battle_open_file)(fileId, data, a3, callback);
	const int effect_id = ff8_externals.battle_magic_id != nullptr ? *ff8_externals.battle_magic_id : -1;
	if (ff8_remastered_edition && fileId == GILGAMESH_G_FILE_ID && (trace_files || trace_all))
		ffnx_trace("Gilgamesh G load: effect_id=%d data=0x%08X result=%d\n", effect_id, uint32_t(data), ret);

	if (ff8_remastered_edition && fileId == GILGAMESH_G_FILE_ID
		&& effect_id >= GILGAMESH_FIRST_EFFECT_ID && effect_id <= GILGAMESH_LAST_EFFECT_ID
		&& ret == 0 && data != nullptr)
	{
		const uint32_t source_offset = FF8_GILGAMESH_G_DESCRIPTOR_SOURCE_OFFSET;
		uint8_t *effect_arena = ((uint8_t *(*)())ff8_externals.get_battle_effect_buffer_sub_571B50)();
		if (effect_arena != nullptr && data == effect_arena + source_offset)
		{
			const uint32_t *g_header = static_cast<const uint32_t *>(data);
			uint32_t *root_header = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t *>(static_cast<uint8_t *>(data) - source_offset);
			uint32_t relocated_offsets[4]{};
			bool offsets_valid = true;

			for (uint32_t field_index = 1; field_index <= 4; ++field_index)
			{
				const uint32_t relative_offset = g_header[field_index];
				if (relative_offset >= FF8_BATTLE_EFFECT_BUFFER_SIZE - source_offset)
				{
					ffnx_warning("Gilgamesh G descriptor offset[%u]=0x%X exceeds the battle effect buffer; skipping relocation.\n",
						field_index, relative_offset);
					offsets_valid = false;
					break;
				}
				relocated_offsets[field_index - 1] = source_offset + relative_offset;
			}

			if (offsets_valid)
			{
				const uint32_t previous_offsets[4] = { root_header[1], root_header[2], root_header[3], root_header[4] };
				for (uint32_t field_index = 1; field_index <= 4; ++field_index)
					root_header[field_index] = relocated_offsets[field_index - 1];

				if (trace_files || trace_all)
					ffnx_trace("Gilgamesh descriptor offsets: G=[%X,%X,%X,%X] B=[%X,%X,%X,%X]->[%X,%X,%X,%X]\n",
						g_header[1], g_header[2], g_header[3], g_header[4],
						previous_offsets[0], previous_offsets[1], previous_offsets[2], previous_offsets[3],
						relocated_offsets[0], relocated_offsets[1], relocated_offsets[2], relocated_offsets[3]);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			ffnx_warning("Gilgamesh G destination 0x%08X does not match the relocated effect-buffer slot, skipping descriptor relocation.\n",
				uint32_t(data));
		}
	}

	// c0mXXX.dat files (battle ennemies)
	if (fileId >= 166 && fileId <= 309 && *(uint32_t *)data == 11)
	{
		char chunk_file[1024]{0};
		byte *chunks_data[11]{nullptr};
		long chunks_size[11]{0};
		bool has_chunk = false;
		char langPath[16] = "/";

		ff8_fs_lang_string(langPath + 1);

		for (int chunkId = 0; chunkId < 11; ++chunkId)
		{
			for (uint8_t lang = 0; lang < 2; lang++)
			{
				_snprintf(chunk_file, sizeof(chunk_file), "%s/%s%s/battle/%s.chunk.%i", basedir, direct_mode_path.c_str(), langPath, ff8_externals.battle_filenames[fileId], chunkId + 1);

				FILE *fd = fopen(chunk_file, "rb");

				if (fd != nullptr)
				{
					if (trace_all || trace_direct) ffnx_info("Direct file using %s\n", chunk_file);

					fseek(fd, 0L, SEEK_END);
					long chunk_size = ftell(fd);
					fseek(fd, 0L, SEEK_SET);

					byte *chunk_data = new byte[chunk_size];

					fread(chunk_data, sizeof(byte), chunk_size, fd);
					fclose(fd);

					chunks_data[chunkId] = chunk_data;
					chunks_size[chunkId] = chunk_size;
					has_chunk = true;
					break;
				}

				if (trace_all || trace_direct) ffnx_warning("Direct file not found %s\n", chunk_file);

				*langPath = '\0';
			}
			*langPath = '/';
		}

		// Rebuild file content with chunks + original data
		if (has_chunk)
		{
			uint32_t *toc = (uint32_t *)data + 1;
			uint32_t cur_data_pos = (11 + 2) * sizeof(uint32_t);
			byte *old_data = new byte[toc[11]];
			memcpy(old_data, data, toc[11] * sizeof(byte));
			uint32_t *old_toc = (uint32_t *)old_data + 1;

			for (int chunkId = 0; chunkId < 11; ++chunkId)
			{
				byte *chunk_data = chunks_data[chunkId];
				long chunk_size;
				toc[chunkId] = cur_data_pos;
				if (chunk_data != nullptr)
				{
					chunk_size = chunks_size[chunkId];
					memcpy((uint8_t *)data + toc[chunkId], chunk_data, chunks_size[chunkId]);
					delete[] chunk_data;
				}
				else
				{
					chunk_size = old_toc[chunkId + 1] - old_toc[chunkId];
					memcpy((uint8_t *)data + toc[chunkId], old_data + old_toc[chunkId], chunk_size);
				}
				cur_data_pos += chunk_size;
			}

			toc[11] = cur_data_pos;

			delete[] old_data;
		}
	}

	return ret;
}

static uint8_t *ff8_remastered_battle_effect_parent_cursor = nullptr;

static void *ff8_remastered_open_exe_dat(const char *fileName, void *data, int dataSize, DWORD *outSize)
{
	if (fileName == nullptr)
	{
		return nullptr;
	}

	const char *baseName = PathFindFileNameA(fileName);
	const char *extension = strrchr(baseName, '.');
	if (extension == nullptr || stricmp(extension, ".dat") != 0)
	{
		return nullptr;
	}

	char archivePath[MAX_PATH] = {};
	snprintf(archivePath, sizeof(archivePath), "data\\exe_dat\\%s", baseName);
	Zzz::File *file = g_FF8ZzzArchiveMain.openFile(archivePath);
	if (file == nullptr)
	{
		return nullptr;
	}

	std::vector<uint8_t> fileData(file->size());
	const int bytesRead = file->read(fileData.data(), unsigned(fileData.size()));
	Zzz::closeFile(file);
	if (bytesRead != int(fileData.size()))
	{
		ffnx_warning("%s: failed to read %s from main.zzz\n", __func__, archivePath);
		return nullptr;
	}

	uint8_t *destination = nullptr;
	if (data != nullptr && dataSize >= 0 && fileData.size() <= size_t(dataSize))
	{
		destination = (uint8_t *)data;
	}
	else
	{
		uint8_t *effect_arena = ((uint8_t *(*)())ff8_externals.get_battle_effect_buffer_sub_571B50)();
		uint8_t *effect_parent_begin = effect_arena + 0x100000;
		uint8_t *effect_parent_end = effect_arena + FF8_BATTLE_EFFECT_BUFFER_SIZE;
		if (data == effect_arena || ff8_remastered_battle_effect_parent_cursor == nullptr)
		{
			ff8_remastered_battle_effect_parent_cursor = effect_parent_begin;
		}

		const size_t alignedSize = (fileData.size() + 3) & ~size_t(3);
		if (ff8_remastered_battle_effect_parent_cursor > effect_parent_end
			|| alignedSize > size_t(effect_parent_end - ff8_remastered_battle_effect_parent_cursor))
		{
			ffnx_warning("%s: %s exceeds the Remastered battle effect arena\n", __func__, archivePath);
			return nullptr;
		}

		destination = ff8_remastered_battle_effect_parent_cursor;
		ff8_remastered_battle_effect_parent_cursor += alignedSize;
	}

	memcpy(destination, fileData.data(), fileData.size());
	if (outSize != nullptr)
	{
		*outSize = DWORD(fileData.size());
	}

	if (trace_all || trace_files)
	{
		ffnx_info("%s: loaded %s from main.zzz (%u bytes)\n", __func__, archivePath, unsigned(fileData.size()));
	}

	return destination;
}

void *ff8_battle_open_effect(const char *fileName, void *data, int dataSize, DWORD *outSize)
{
	if (trace_all || trace_vram) ffnx_trace("%s: %s\n", __func__, fileName);

	battle_texture_id = 0;
	snprintf(battle_texture_name, sizeof(battle_texture_name), "magic/%s", fileName);

	auto open_effect = (void *(*)(const char*,void*,int,DWORD*))ff8_externals.load_magic_data_sub_571900;
	if (ff8_remastered_edition)
	{
		void *exeDat = ff8_remastered_open_exe_dat(fileName, data, dataSize, outSize);
		if (exeDat != nullptr)
		{
			return exeDat;
		}
	}

	if (!ff8_remastered_edition || data == nullptr)
		return open_effect(fileName, data, dataSize, outSize);

	uint8_t *effect_arena = ((uint8_t *(*)())ff8_externals.get_battle_effect_buffer_sub_571B50)();
	uint8_t *effect_parent_begin = effect_arena + 0x100000;
	uint8_t *effect_parent_end = effect_arena + FF8_BATTLE_EFFECT_BUFFER_SIZE;
	if (data == effect_arena || ff8_remastered_battle_effect_parent_cursor == nullptr)
		ff8_remastered_battle_effect_parent_cursor = effect_parent_begin;

	uint8_t *destination = ff8_remastered_battle_effect_parent_cursor;
	void *result = open_effect(fileName, destination, int(effect_parent_end - destination), outSize);
	if (result == destination && outSize != nullptr && *outSize <= DWORD(effect_parent_end - destination))
		ff8_remastered_battle_effect_parent_cursor += (*outSize + 3) & ~DWORD(3); // mag201_b.00 has an odd size

	return result;
}

size_t ff8_battle_read_file(char *fileName, void *data)
{
	if (trace_all || trace_vram) ffnx_trace("%s: %s\n", __func__, fileName);

	size_t file_size = ff8_externals.sm_pc_read(fileName, data);

	if (save_textures && StrStrIA(fileName, ".X") != nullptr) {
		ff8_battle_stage_parse_geometry((uint8_t *)data, file_size, stage);
	}

	return file_size;
}

int battle_get_texture_header_index(uint8_t *texture_buffer)
{
	for (int i = 0; i < battle_texture_data_list_size; ++i) {
		if (battle_texture_headers.at(i).data == texture_buffer) {
			return i;
		}
	}

	return -1;
}

void battle_read_effect_alloc()
{
	if (trace_all || trace_vram) ffnx_trace("%s: magic_id=%d\n", __func__, *ff8_externals.battle_magic_id);
	ff8_remastered_battle_effect_parent_cursor = nullptr;

	// Reset list
	for (int i = 0; i < battle_texture_headers.size(); ++i) {
		battle_texture_headers[i] = BattleTextureHeader();
	}
	battle_texture_headers_cursor = 0;
	// Guess the filename until a file is actually opened
	battle_texture_id = 0;
	snprintf(battle_texture_name, sizeof(battle_texture_name), "magic/mag%03d.tim", *ff8_externals.battle_magic_id);

	((void(*)())ff8_externals.sub_571870)();
}

void battle_set_texture_header(uint8_t file_id, bool is_palette, uint8_t file_relative_id, int16_t *pos_and_size, uint8_t *texture_buffer)
{
	if (trace_all || trace_vram) ffnx_trace("%s: effect_id=%d file_id=%d is_palette=%d file_relative_id=%d pos_and_size=(%d, %d, %d, %d) texture_buffer=0x%X battle_texture_headers_cursor=%d\n", __func__,
		*ff8_externals.battle_magic_id, file_id, is_palette, file_relative_id,
		pos_and_size[0], pos_and_size[1], pos_and_size[2], pos_and_size[3], texture_buffer, battle_texture_headers_cursor);

	BattleTextureHeader header = BattleTextureHeader();
	header.effect_id = *ff8_externals.battle_magic_id;
	header.file_id = file_id;
	header.is_palette = is_palette;
	header.file_relative_id = file_relative_id;
	header.x = pos_and_size[0];
	header.y = pos_and_size[1];
	header.w = pos_and_size[2];
	header.h = pos_and_size[3];
	header.data = texture_buffer;

	int index = battle_get_texture_header_index(texture_buffer);

	if (index < 0) {
		battle_texture_headers[battle_texture_headers_cursor] = header;

		battle_texture_headers_cursor = (battle_texture_headers_cursor + 1) % battle_texture_data_list_size;
	} else {
		battle_texture_headers[index] = header;
	}
}

void ff8_battle_set_palette_data_from_mag(int file_relative_id)
{
	if (trace_all || trace_vram) ffnx_trace("%s: file_relative_id=%d\n", __func__, file_relative_id);

	int file_ext_number = *(uint8_t *)(*(*ff8_externals.effect_struct_27973EC + 42) + file_relative_id);

	uint8_t *data = ff8_externals.mag_data_dword_2798A68[file_ext_number];
	uint8_t *texture_data = data + *(DWORD *)(data + 8) + *(DWORD *)(data + *(DWORD *)(data + 8) + 4 * file_relative_id);
	*(*ff8_externals.effect_struct_2797624 + 63) = DWORD(texture_data);
	*(*ff8_externals.effect_struct_2797624 + 60) = *(*ff8_externals.effect_struct_27973EC + 39) + 8 * file_relative_id;

	battle_set_texture_header(file_ext_number, true, file_relative_id, *(int16_t **)(*ff8_externals.effect_struct_2797624 + 60), texture_data);
}

void ff8_battle_set_texture_data_from_mag(int file_relative_id)
{
	if (trace_all || trace_vram) ffnx_trace("%s: file_relative_id=%d\n", __func__, file_relative_id);

	BYTE file_ext_infos = *(BYTE *)(*(*ff8_externals.effect_struct_27973EC + 41) + file_relative_id);
	int file_ext_number = file_ext_infos & 0x7F;

	*(*ff8_externals.effect_struct_2797624 + 62) = file_ext_infos & 0x80;
	uint8_t *texture_data1 = ff8_externals.mag_data_dword_2798A68[file_ext_number] + *(DWORD *)(ff8_externals.mag_data_dword_2798A68[file_ext_number] + 20);
	uint8_t *texture_data = texture_data1 + ((unsigned int)0xFFFFFF & *(DWORD *)(texture_data1 + 4 * file_relative_id));
	*(*ff8_externals.effect_struct_2797624 + 63) = DWORD(texture_data);
	int pos_and_size = *(*ff8_externals.effect_struct_27973EC + 38) + 8 * file_relative_id;
	*(*ff8_externals.effect_struct_2797624 + 60) = pos_and_size;
	WORD *v4 = *(WORD **)(*ff8_externals.effect_struct_2797624 + 60);
	*(WORD *)&pos_and_size = *v4;
	*(*ff8_externals.effect_struct_2797624 + 61) = *(*ff8_externals.effect_struct_2797624 + 62) | *(*ff8_externals.dword_27973E8 + 146) & 0x60 | ((v4[1] & 0x100 | (pos_and_size >> 2) & 0x3F0) >> 4);

	battle_set_texture_header(file_ext_number, false, file_relative_id, *(int16_t **)(*ff8_externals.effect_struct_2797624 + 60), texture_data);
}

void *battle_set_texture_action_upload_raw_pal_call(int16_t *pos_and_size, char *texture_data)
{
	if (trace_all || trace_vram) ffnx_trace("%s: pos=(%d, %d) size=(%d, %d) texture_data=0x%X\n", __func__, pos_and_size[0], pos_and_size[1], pos_and_size[2], pos_and_size[3], texture_data);

	battle_set_texture_header(0, true, 0, pos_and_size, (uint8_t *)texture_data);

	return ((void*(*)(int16_t*,char*))ff8_externals.sub_505DF0)(pos_and_size, texture_data);
}

void ff8_battle_upload_texture_raw(int16_t *pos_and_size, uint8_t *texture_buffer)
{
	int index = battle_get_texture_header_index(texture_buffer);

	if (index >= 0) {
		const BattleTextureHeader &header = battle_texture_headers.at(index);

		if (trace_all || trace_vram) ffnx_trace("%s: texture identified is_pal=%d rect=(%d, %d, %d, %d) effect_id=%d file_id=%d file_relative_id=%d\n", __func__,
			header.is_palette, header.x, header.y, header.w, header.h, header.effect_id, header.file_id, header.file_relative_id);

		if (header.is_palette) {
			next_pal_data = (uint16_t *)texture_buffer;
		} else {
			uint16_t minX = 0xFFFF, maxX = 0, minY = 0xFFFF, maxY = 0;
			int index2 = index;

			for (int i = 1; i < battle_texture_data_list_size; ++i) {
				const BattleTextureHeader &header2 = battle_texture_headers.at((index + i) % battle_texture_data_list_size);
				if (!header2.is_palette) {
					break;
				}

				if (minX > header2.x) {
					minX = header2.x;
				}
				if (minY > header2.y) {
					minY = header2.y;
				}
				if (maxX < header2.x + header2.w) {
					maxX = header2.x + header2.w;
				}
				if (maxY < header2.y + header2.h) {
					maxY = header2.y + header2.h;
				}
			}

			snprintf(next_texture_name, sizeof(next_texture_name), "magic/MAG%03d_B.%02d-%d", header.effect_id, header.file_id, header.file_relative_id);
				bool texture_saved = false;

			if (minY != 0xFFFF) {
				next_bpp = maxX - minX == 16 ? Tim::Bpp4 : Tim::Bpp8;
				texture_infos = TexturePacker::TextureInfos(pos_and_size[0], pos_and_size[1], pos_and_size[2], pos_and_size[3], next_bpp);
				palette_infos = TexturePacker::TextureInfos(minX, minY, maxX - minX, maxY - minY, next_bpp);

				if (save_textures) {
					int last_pal_x = -1, last_pal_y = -1;

					for (int i = 1; i < battle_texture_data_list_size; ++i) {
						const BattleTextureHeader &header2 = battle_texture_headers.at((index + i) % battle_texture_data_list_size);
						if (!header2.is_palette || (last_pal_y >= 0 && std::abs(header2.y - last_pal_y) > 10) || (last_pal_x >= 0 && last_pal_x != header.x)) {
							break;
						}

						ff8_tim tim_infos = ff8_tim();
						tim_infos.pal_data = (uint16_t *)header2.data;
						tim_infos.pal_w = header2.w;
						tim_infos.pal_h = header2.h;
						tim_infos.img_data = texture_buffer;
						tim_infos.img_w = pos_and_size[2];
						tim_infos.img_h = pos_and_size[3];
						Tim(next_bpp, tim_infos).save(next_texture_name, header2.y - minY, true);
						texture_saved = true;

						last_pal_x = header2.x;
						last_pal_y = header2.y;

						// We assume that the first palette is correct, so we remove it from the array. The others maybe not, so keep them
						if (i == 1) {
							battle_texture_headers[(index + i) % battle_texture_data_list_size] = BattleTextureHeader();
						}
					}
				}
			} else {
				next_bpp = Tim::Bpp8;
			}

			// We don't know the palette
			if (save_textures && !texture_saved) {
				ff8_tim tim_infos = ff8_tim();
				tim_infos.img_data = texture_buffer;
				tim_infos.img_w = pos_and_size[2];
				tim_infos.img_h = pos_and_size[3];
				Tim(next_bpp, tim_infos).save(next_texture_name, uint8_t(0), true);
			}

			battle_texture_headers[index] = BattleTextureHeader();
		}
	} else {
		int index = battle_get_texture_file_name_index(texture_buffer);

		if (index >= 0) {
			if (trace_all || trace_vram) ffnx_trace("%s: texture data identified 0x%X\n", __func__, texture_buffer);

			strncpy(next_texture_name, battle_texture_data_list[index].file_name, sizeof(battle_texture_data_list[index].file_name));

			battle_texture_data_list[index] = BattleTextureFileName();

			next_bpp = Tim::Bpp8;
			bool skip_save_textures = false;

			// Splitted version of A8DEF.TIM
			if (stricmp(next_texture_name, "battle/MA8DEF_P.0") == 0) {
				next_bpp = Tim::Bpp4;
				skip_save_textures = true;
				strncpy(next_texture_name, "battle/A8DEF0.TIM", sizeof(next_texture_name));
			} else if (stricmp(next_texture_name, "battle/MA8DEF_P.1") == 0) {
				next_bpp = Tim::Bpp4;
				skip_save_textures = true;
				strncpy(next_texture_name, "battle/A8DEF1.TIM", sizeof(next_texture_name));
			} else if (stricmp(next_texture_name, "battle/MA8DEF_P.2") == 0) {
				next_bpp = Tim::Bpp4;
				skip_save_textures = true;
				strncpy(next_texture_name, "battle/A8DEF2.TIM", sizeof(next_texture_name));
			}

			if (save_textures && !skip_save_textures) {
				ff8_tim tim_infos = ff8_tim();
				tim_infos.img_data = texture_buffer;
				tim_infos.img_x = pos_and_size[0];
				tim_infos.img_y = pos_and_size[1];
				tim_infos.img_w = pos_and_size[2];
				tim_infos.img_h = pos_and_size[3];
				// Save without palette
				Tim(next_bpp, tim_infos).save(next_texture_name);

				// Save with every palettes we know
				for (int i = 1; i < battle_texture_data_list_size; ++i) {
					const BattleTextureHeader &header = battle_texture_headers.at(i % battle_texture_data_list_size);
					if (!header.is_palette) {
						continue;
					}

					char fileName[MAX_PATH] = {};

					snprintf(fileName, sizeof(fileName), "%s-pal-guess-%dx%d", next_texture_name, header.x, header.y);

					tim_infos.pal_data = (uint16_t *)header.data;
					tim_infos.pal_w = header.w;
					tim_infos.pal_h = header.h;
					Tim(next_bpp, tim_infos).save(fileName, true);
				}
			}
		} else {
			if (trace_all || trace_vram) ffnx_warning("%s: unknown texture uploaded\n", __func__);

			if (pos_and_size[2] > 32 && pos_and_size[3] > 32) {
				snprintf(next_texture_name, sizeof(next_texture_name), "magic/mag%03d.tim-%d", *ff8_externals.battle_magic_id, battle_texture_id);
				++battle_texture_id;
				next_bpp = Tim::Bpp8;

				if (save_textures) {
					ff8_tim tim_infos = ff8_tim();
					tim_infos.img_data = texture_buffer;
					tim_infos.img_x = pos_and_size[0];
					tim_infos.img_y = pos_and_size[1];
					tim_infos.img_w = pos_and_size[2];
					tim_infos.img_h = pos_and_size[3];
					// Save without palette
					Tim(next_bpp, tim_infos).save(next_texture_name);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ff8_upload_vram(pos_and_size, texture_buffer);
}

void ff8_battle_upload_texture_palette(int16_t *pos_and_size, uint8_t *texture_buffer)
{
	if (trace_all || trace_vram) ffnx_trace("%s: %s battle_texture_id=%d\n", __func__, battle_texture_name, battle_texture_id);

	Tim tim = Tim::fromTimData(texture_buffer - 20);
	next_pal_data = (uint16_t *)texture_buffer;

	ff8_upload_vram(pos_and_size, texture_buffer);

	texture_infos = TexturePacker::TextureInfos(tim.imageX(), tim.imageY(), tim.imageWidth(), tim.imageHeight(), tim.bpp());
	palette_infos = TexturePacker::TextureInfos(tim.paletteX(), tim.paletteY(), tim.paletteWidth(), tim.paletteHeight(), Tim::Bpp16);

	next_bpp = tim.bpp();
	if (stricmp(battle_texture_name, "battle/A8DEF.TIM") == 0) {
		// Exceptionally split the texture into 3 pages, because the game will reupload page by page later (via MA8DEF textures)
		texture_infos = TexturePacker::TextureInfos(tim.imageX(), tim.imageY(), 64, tim.imageHeight(), tim.bpp());
		strncpy(next_texture_name, "battle/A8DEF0.TIM", sizeof(next_texture_name));
		texturePacker.setTexture(next_texture_name, nullptr, texture_infos, palette_infos);
		texture_infos = TexturePacker::TextureInfos(tim.imageX() + 64, tim.imageY(), 64, tim.imageHeight(), tim.bpp());
		strncpy(next_texture_name, "battle/A8DEF1.TIM", sizeof(next_texture_name));
		texturePacker.setTexture(next_texture_name, nullptr, texture_infos, palette_infos);
		texture_infos = TexturePacker::TextureInfos(tim.imageX() + 128, tim.imageY(), 64, tim.imageHeight(), tim.bpp());
		strncpy(next_texture_name, "battle/A8DEF2.TIM", sizeof(next_texture_name));
		texturePacker.setTexture(next_texture_name, nullptr, texture_infos, palette_infos);
		texture_infos = TexturePacker::TextureInfos(); // Bypass next upload vram
	} else if (battle_texture_id < 0) {
		strncpy(next_texture_name, battle_texture_name, sizeof(next_texture_name));
	} else {
		if (strncmp(battle_texture_name, "battle/", sizeof("battle/") - 1) == 0) {
			// Remove extension
			strncpy(next_texture_name, ff8_externals.battle_filenames[battle_file_id], strlen(ff8_externals.battle_filenames[battle_file_id]) - 4);
			next_texture_name[strlen(ff8_externals.battle_filenames[battle_file_id]) - 4] = '\0';

			if (!is_remastered_hd_textures_disabled("battle")) {
				if (!set_remastered_battle_texture_name(next_remastered_texture_name, sizeof(next_remastered_texture_name), next_texture_name, battle_texture_name, battle_texture_id))
				{
					snprintf(next_remastered_texture_name, sizeof(next_remastered_texture_name), "battle.fs\\hd_new\\%s_%d", next_texture_name, battle_texture_id);
				}
			}
		}
		else if (ff8_remastered_edition && !is_remastered_hd_textures_disabled("battle")
			&& strncmp(battle_texture_name, "magic/", sizeof("magic/") - 1) == 0)
		{
			const char *fileName = battle_texture_name + sizeof("magic/") - 1;
			const char *extension = strrchr(fileName, '.');
			if (extension != nullptr && stricmp(extension, ".tim") == 0)
			{
				char classicName[MAX_PATH] = {};
				snprintf(classicName, sizeof(classicName), "%.*s", int(extension - fileName), fileName);
				set_remastered_battle_texture_name(next_remastered_texture_name, sizeof(next_remastered_texture_name),
					classicName, battle_texture_name, battle_texture_id);
			}
		}
		snprintf(next_texture_name, sizeof(next_texture_name), "%s-%d", battle_texture_name, battle_texture_id);
		++battle_texture_id;
	}

	if (save_textures) {
		if (stricmp(battle_texture_name, "battle/A8DEF.TIM") == 0) {
			Tim chunk1 = tim.chunk(0, 0, 64, 256),
				chunk2 = tim.chunk(64, 0, 64, 256),
				chunk3 = tim.chunk(128, 0, 64, 256);
			for (int pal = 0; pal < palette_infos.h(); ++pal) {
				chunk1.save("battle/A8DEF0.TIM", 0, pal, true);
				chunk2.save("battle/A8DEF1.TIM", 0, pal, true);
				chunk3.save("battle/A8DEF2.TIM", 0, pal, true);
			}
		} else if (StrStrIA(battle_texture_name, ".X") != nullptr) {
			ff8_battle_state_save_texture(stage, tim, next_texture_name);
		} else if (palette_infos.h() > 1) {
			for (int pal = 0; pal < palette_infos.h(); ++pal) {
				tim.save(next_texture_name, 0, pal, true);
			}
		} else {
			tim.save(next_texture_name, 0, 0, true);
		}
	}
}

void engine_set_init_time(double fps_adjust)
{
	texturePacker.clearTextures();

	palette_infos = TexturePacker::TextureInfos();
	texture_infos = TexturePacker::TextureInfos();

	((void(*)(double))ff8_externals.engine_set_init_time)(fps_adjust);
}

void clean_psxvram_pages()
{
	texturePacker.clearTiledTexs();

	palette_infos = TexturePacker::TextureInfos();
	texture_infos = TexturePacker::TextureInfos();

	((void(*)())ff8_externals.sub_4672C0)();
}

void vram_init()
{
	replace_function(ff8_externals.upload_psx_vram, ff8_upload_vram);
	replace_function(ff8_externals.copy_psx_vram_part, ff8_copy_vram_part);

	// pubintro
	replace_call(ff8_externals.open_lzs_image + 0x72, ff8_credits_open_texture);
	// cdcheck
	replace_call(ff8_externals.cdcheck_sub_52F9E0 + 0x1DC, ff8_cdcheck_error_upload_vram);
	// Triple Triad
	replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_5391B0 + 0x49, ff8_upload_vram_triple_triad_1);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_5391B0 + 0x1CC, ff8_upload_vram_triple_triad_2_palette);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_5391B0 + 0x1E1, ff8_upload_vram_triple_triad_2_data);
	// worldmap
	replace_call(ff8_externals.worldmap_sub_53F310_call_24D, ff8_wm_set_section_positions); // Replaced to clear the textures on module loading
	replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_554940_call_130, ff8_wm_section_17_upload); // Waves
	replace_call(ff8_externals.worldmap_sub_53F310_call_2A9, ff8_wm_section_38_prepare_texture_for_upload);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.worldmap_sub_53F310_call_30D, ff8_upload_vram_wm_section_38_palette);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.worldmap_sub_53F310_call_330, ff8_wm_section_39_upload); // Rails/Roads
	replace_call(ff8_externals.worldmap_sub_53F310_call_366, ff8_wm_section_40_upload);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.worldmap_sub_554AA0_call_C2, ff8_wm_section_41_upload_palette); // Animated palettes
	replace_call(ff8_externals.worldmap_sub_548020 + 0x47, ff8_wm_section_42_upload); // Train/vehicles
	replace_call(ff8_externals.worldmap_chara_one + 0xCC, ff8_wm_chara_one_read_file);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.worldmap_chara_one + 0x4D1, ff8_wm_chara_one_upload_texture_2); // Characters/Chocobos/Ragnarok
	replace_call(ff8_externals.worldmap_chara_one + 0x566, ff8_wm_chara_one_upload_palette_2);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.worldmap_chara_one + 0x675, wm_chara_one_push_polygons_selphie_patch); // Patch Selphie
	replace_call(ff8_externals.worldmap_input_update_sub_559240 + (FF8_US_VERSION ? 0x263 : 0x260), ff8_wm_update_fence_animation);
	// wm texl project
	replace_call(ff8_externals.upload_psxvram_texl_pal_call1, ff8_wm_texl_palette_upload_vram);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.upload_psxvram_texl_pal_call2, ff8_wm_texl_palette_upload_vram);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.open_file_world_sub_52D670_texl_call1, ff8_wm_open_data);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.open_file_world_sub_52D670_texl_call2, ff8_wm_open_data);
	// field: background
	replace_call(ff8_externals.upload_mim_file + 0x2E, ff8_field_mim_palette_upload_vram);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.read_field_data + (JP_VERSION ? 0x990 : 0x915), ff8_field_read_map_data);
	// field: characters
	replace_call(ff8_externals.read_field_data + (JP_VERSION ? 0xFA2 : 0xF0F), ff8_field_open_chara_one);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.load_field_models + 0x15F, ff8_field_chara_one_read_file_header);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.load_field_models + 0x582, ff8_field_chara_one_seek_to_model);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.load_field_models + 0x594, ff8_field_chara_one_read_model);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.load_field_models + 0x879, ff8_field_chara_one_read_mch);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.load_field_models + 0xB72, ff8_field_texture_upload_one);
	// field: effects
	replace_call(ff8_externals.upload_pmp_file + 0x7F, ff8_field_effects_upload_vram1);
	// battle
	// battle: File System
	replace_call(ff8_externals.battle_open_file_wrapper + 0x14, ff8_battle_open_and_read_file);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.load_magic_data_sub_5718E0 + 0xB, ff8_battle_open_effect);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.load_magic_data_sub_571B80 + 0x1E, ff8_battle_open_effect);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.battle_open_file + 0x8E, ff8_battle_read_file);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.battle_open_file + 0x1A2, ff8_battle_read_file);
	// battle: Effects
	replace_call(ff8_externals.battle_read_effect_sub_50AF20 + 0x63, battle_read_effect_alloc);
	replace_function(ff8_externals.mag_data_palette_sub_B66560, ff8_battle_set_palette_data_from_mag);
	replace_function(ff8_externals.mag_data_texture_sub_B66560, ff8_battle_set_texture_data_from_mag);
	// battle: Upload texture
	replace_call(ff8_externals.battle_set_action_upload_raw_palette_sub_B66400 + 0x68, battle_set_texture_action_upload_raw_pal_call);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.battle_upload_texture_to_vram + 0x2E, ff8_battle_upload_texture_raw);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.battle_upload_texture_to_vram + 0x45, ff8_battle_upload_texture_palette);

	//---- VRAM reads

	// read_vram_to_buffer_parent_calls
	replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_464BD0 + 0x53, read_vram_to_buffer_parent_call1);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_464BD0 + 0xED, read_vram_to_buffer_parent_call1);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_464BD0 + 0x1A1, read_vram_to_buffer_parent_call1);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.ssigpu_tx_select_2_sub_465CE0 + 0x281, read_vram_to_buffer_parent_call1_tx_select);

	replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_464BD0 + 0x79, read_vram_to_buffer_parent_call2);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_464BD0 + 0x1B5, read_vram_to_buffer_parent_call2);

	// read_vram_to_buffer_with_palette1_parent_calls
	replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_464BD0 + 0xFC, read_vram_to_buffer_with_palette1_parent_call1);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.ssigpu_tx_select_2_sub_465CE0 + 0x2CF, read_vram_to_buffer_with_palette1_parent_call1);

	replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_464BD0 + 0xAF, read_vram_to_buffer_with_palette1_parent_call2);

	// read_vram_to_buffer_with_palette2_parent_calls
	replace_call(ff8_externals.ssigpu_callbacks_2[100] + 0x33, read_vram_to_buffer_with_palette2_parent_call);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.ssigpu_callbacks_2[116] + 0x2E, read_vram_to_buffer_with_palette2_parent_call);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.ssigpu_callbacks_2[124] + 0x2E, read_vram_to_buffer_with_palette2_parent_call);

	replace_call(uint32_t(ff8_externals.sub_464F70) + 0x2C5, read_vram_to_buffer);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_4653B0 + 0x9D, read_vram_to_buffer);

	replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_464DB0 + 0xEC, read_vram_to_buffer_with_palette1);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_465720 + 0xA5, read_vram_to_buffer_with_palette1);

	// Not used?
	replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_4649A0 + 0x13F, read_vram_to_buffer_with_palette2);

	// Read palette from VRAM to Graphic driver
	replace_call(ff8_externals.write_palette_texture_set_sub_466190 + 0x2C, ff8_read_vram_palette);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.write_palette_texture_set_sub_466190 + 0x7E, ff8_write_palette_to_driver);

	//---- Misc

	// Fix missing textures in battle module by clearing custom textures
	replace_call(ff8_externals.battle_enter + 0x35, engine_set_init_time);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.credits_enter + 0x12, engine_set_init_time);
	// Clear texture_packer on every module exits
	replace_call(ff8_externals.psxvram_texture_pages_free + 0x5A, clean_psxvram_pages);
	// Free pc_name in tex_header
	replace_call(ff8_externals.psxvram_texture_page_free + 0x98, free_tex_header);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.psxvram_texture_page_free + 0xAF, free_tex_header);
}
```

```cpp
struct ff8_card_background
{
	uint32_t texture = 0;
	bool attempted = false;
	uint32_t frame = 0;
	bool drawn = false;
	bool traced_draw = false;
};

static ff8_card_background ff8_card_backgrounds[2];
struct ff8_card_background_packet
{
	int background;
	bool first_page;
};

static int ff8_card_background_source = -1;
static int ff8_card_background_sprite = -1;
static std::unordered_map<const void *, ff8_card_background_packet> ff8_card_background_packets;
static std::unordered_map<const void *, int> ff8_card_background_objects;
static uint32_t (*ff8_card_submit_background)(int *, uint32_t *, int, int, int, int);
static void (*ff8_card_draw_sprite)(uint32_t *);
static int (*ff8_card_append_sprite)(int, ff8_graphics_object *);

void ff8_widescreen_reset_card_backgrounds()
{
	for (auto &background : ff8_card_backgrounds)
	{
		if (background.texture) newRenderer.deleteTexture(background.texture);
		background = {};
	}
	ff8_card_background_source = -1;
	ff8_card_background_sprite = -1;
	ff8_card_background_packets.clear();
	ff8_card_background_objects.clear();
}

static uint32_t ff8_load_wide_card_background(ff8_card_background &background, const char *name)
{
	if (background.attempted) return background.texture;
	background.attempted = true;

	char language[16] = {};
	ff8_fs_lang_string(language);
	const char *aspect = aspect_ratio == AR_WIDESCREEN_16X10 ? "16x10" : "16x9";
	const float expected_ratio = aspect_ratio == AR_WIDESCREEN_16X10 ? 1.6f : 16.0f / 9.0f;

	for (const auto &path : {override_mod_path, mod_path})
	{
		if (path.empty()) continue;
		for (const auto &extension : mod_ext)
		{
			for (const char *locale : std::initializer_list<const char *>{language, ""})
			{
				char filename[sizeof(basedir) + 1024] = {};
				const int length = snprintf(filename, sizeof(filename), "%s\\%s\\%s%s%s_%s_00.%s",
					basedir, path.c_str(), locale, *locale ? "\\" : "", name, aspect, extension.c_str());
				if (length < 0 || length >= sizeof(filename))
				{
					ffnx_warning("Card widescreen background path is too long: %s\n", name);
					continue;
				}
				if (!fileExists(filename)) continue;

				uint32_t width = 0, height = 0;
				const uint32_t texture = load_texture_helper(filename, &width, &height, extension == "png", true);
				if (!texture)
				{
					ffnx_warning("Could not load Card widescreen background: %s\n", filename);
					continue;
				}
				if (!width || !height || width > max_texture_size || height > max_texture_size
					|| std::abs(float(width) / height - expected_ratio) > 0.01f)
				{
					ffnx_warning("Card widescreen background must have aspect ratio %s and supported dimensions: %s (%ux%u)\n",
						aspect, filename, width, height);
					newRenderer.deleteTexture(texture);
					continue;
				}
				background.texture = texture;
				return texture;
			}
		}
	}
	if (trace_all || trace_loaders)
		ffnx_trace("No usable Card widescreen background for %s (%s); keeping native background\n", name, aspect);
	return 0;
}

void ff8_widescreen_set_card_background_source(const uint8_t *image)
{
	ff8_card_background_source = image == ff8_externals.cardgame_tim_texture_intro ? 0
		: image == ff8_externals.cardgame_tim_texture_game ? 1 : -1;
}

static uint32_t ff8_card_submit_background_page(int *ordering_table, uint32_t *packet, int z0, int z1, int z2, int z3, bool first_page)
{
	const uint32_t result = ff8_card_submit_background(ordering_table, packet, z0, z1, z2, z3);
	if (getmode_cached()->driver_mode == MODE_CARDGAME && ff8_card_background_source >= 0)
		ff8_card_background_packets[packet] = {ff8_card_background_source, first_page};
	else
		ff8_card_background_packets.erase(packet);
	return result;
}

static uint32_t ff8_card_submit_first_background_page(int *ordering_table, uint32_t *packet, int z0, int z1, int z2, int z3)
{
	return ff8_card_submit_background_page(ordering_table, packet, z0, z1, z2, z3, true);
}

static uint32_t ff8_card_submit_second_background_page(int *ordering_table, uint32_t *packet, int z0, int z1, int z2, int z3)
{
	return ff8_card_submit_background_page(ordering_table, packet, z0, z1, z2, z3, false);
}

static void ff8_card_draw_background_sprite(uint32_t *packet)
{
	const auto it = ff8_card_background_packets.find(packet);
	if (it == ff8_card_background_packets.end())
	{
		ff8_card_draw_sprite(packet);
		return;
	}
	const ff8_card_background_packet background_packet = it->second;
	ff8_card_background_packets.erase(it);
	const int index = background_packet.background;
	const char *name = index == 0 ? "cardgame\\intro" : "cardgame\\game";
	if (!ff8_load_wide_card_background(ff8_card_backgrounds[index], name))
	{
		ff8_card_draw_sprite(packet);
		return;
	}
	if (!background_packet.first_page) return;

	// The callback appends to native batches; retain the background's identity until those batches draw.
	const int previous_sprite = ff8_card_background_sprite;
	ff8_card_background_sprite = index;
	ff8_card_draw_sprite(packet);
	ff8_card_background_sprite = previous_sprite;
}

static int ff8_card_append_background_sprite(int count, ff8_graphics_object *graphics_object)
{
	const int result = ff8_card_append_sprite(count, graphics_object);
	if (ff8_card_background_sprite >= 0 && result)
		ff8_card_background_objects[graphics_object] = ff8_card_background_sprite;
	else
		ff8_card_background_objects.erase(graphics_object);
	return result;
}

bool ff8_widescreen_draw_card_background(uint32_t primitivetype, uint32_t vertextype, const nvertex *vertices, const graphics_object *graphics_object, uint32_t clip)
{
	if (!widescreen_enabled || getmode_cached()->driver_mode != MODE_CARDGAME) return false;
	const auto it = ff8_card_background_objects.find(graphics_object);
	if (it == ff8_card_background_objects.end()) return false;
	auto &background = ff8_card_backgrounds[it->second];
	const uint32_t texture = background.texture;
	if (!texture) return false;
	if (!background.traced_draw && (trace_all || trace_loaders))
	{
		ffnx_trace("Card background draw: %s (native background graphics object %p)\n",
			it->second == 0 ? "cardgame\\intro" : "cardgame\\game", graphics_object);
		background.traced_draw = true;
	}

	// Native clipping can split the first page into multiple graphics objects.
	if (background.drawn && background.frame == frame_counter) return true;
	background.frame = frame_counter;
	background.drawn = true;
	nvertex quad[4] = {vertices[0], vertices[0], vertices[0], vertices[0]};
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
	{
		quad[i]._.x = wide_viewport_x + (i >= 2 ? wide_viewport_width : 0);
		quad[i]._.y = wide_viewport_y + (i % 2 ? wide_viewport_height : 0);
		quad[i].u = i >= 2 ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
		quad[i].v = i % 2 ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
	}
	uint16_t quad_indices[] = {0, 1, 2, 1, 3, 2};
	driver_state saved_state;
	gl_save_state(&saved_state);
	VOBJ(texture_set, texture_set, saved_state.texture_set);
	gl_set_texture(texture, nullptr);
	current_state.texture_filter = true;
	newRenderer.isExternalTexture(true);
	gl_draw_indexed_primitive(primitivetype, TLVERTEX, quad, nullptr, 4, quad_indices, 6, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, 0, 0);
	gl_load_state(&saved_state);
	newRenderer.isExternalTexture(saved_state.texture_set && VREF(texture_set, ogl.external) != 0);
	newRenderer.doScissorTest(clip != 0);
	return true;
}

static bool ff8_is_widescreen_mode(uint32_t mode)
{
	return mode == MODE_BATTLE || mode == MODE_WORLDMAP || mode == MODE_SWIRL
		|| mode == MODE_MENU || mode == MODE_MAIN_MENU;
}

void ff8_clear(uint32_t clear_color, uint32_t clear_depth, uint32_t unknown, struct game_obj *game_object)
{
	// Native-size scenes must not retain pixels outside their viewport from a preceding widescreen scene.
	const bool clear_native_viewport = widescreen_enabled && !ff8_is_widescreen_mode(getmode_cached()->driver_mode);
	common_clear(clear_color || clear_native_viewport, clear_depth, unknown, game_object);
}

void* ff8_engine_set_wide_viewport(int x, int y, int w, int h)
{
	const bool use_wide_viewport = ff8_is_widescreen_mode(getmode()->driver_mode);
	const int viewport_x = use_wide_viewport ? wide_viewport_x : x;
	const int viewport_y = use_wide_viewport ? wide_viewport_y : y;
	const int viewport_width = use_wide_viewport ? wide_viewport_width : w;
	const int viewport_height = use_wide_viewport ? wide_viewport_height : h;

	*ff8_externals.current_viewport_x_dword_1A7764C = viewport_x;
	*ff8_externals.current_viewport_y_dword_1A77648 = viewport_y;
	*ff8_externals.current_viewport_width_dword_1A77654 = viewport_width;
	*ff8_externals.current_viewport_height_dword_1A77650 = viewport_height;

	*ff8_externals.ssigpu_viewport_x_dword_1CA89D8 = x;
	*ff8_externals.ssigpu_viewport_y_dword_1CA89DC = y;
	*ff8_externals.ssigpu_viewport_width_dword_B7CBF8 = w;
	*ff8_externals.ssigpu_viewport_height_dword_B7CBFC = h;

	if ( w >= 540 || h >= 380 )
	{
		if ( *ff8_externals.dword_B7CE28 != -1 )
			*ff8_externals.flag_d3d_renderer_related_dword_1CCFD94 = *ff8_externals.dword_B7CE28;
	}
	else
	{
		int tmp = *ff8_externals.flag_d3d_renderer_related_dword_1CCFD94;
		*ff8_externals.flag_d3d_renderer_related_dword_1CCFD94 = 0;
		*ff8_externals.dword_B7CE28 = tmp;
	}

	return ff8_externals.engine_setviewport_sub_41E070(viewport_x, viewport_y, viewport_width, viewport_height, common_externals.get_game_object());
}

void* ff8_swirl_set_wide_viewport(int x, int y, int w, int h)
{
	x = 0;
	y = 0;
	w = 640;
	h = 480;

	*ff8_externals.swirl_viewport_x = x;
	*ff8_externals.swirl_viewport_y = y;
	*ff8_externals.swirl_viewport_width = w;
	*ff8_externals.swirl_viewport_height = h;

	return ff8_engine_set_wide_viewport(x, y, w, h);
}

static bool ff8_battle_stage_projection = false;
static void **ff8_battle_active_effect = nullptr;
static void *ff8_the_end_effect = nullptr;

int ff8_battle_stage_draw(uint32_t *model, int descriptor, int depth_table, int depth_shift, int output)
{
	const bool previous_stage_projection = ff8_battle_stage_projection;
	ff8_battle_stage_projection = true;
	const int result = reinterpret_cast<int (*)(uint32_t *, int, int, int, int)>(ff8_externals.sub_5099D0)(model, descriptor, depth_table, depth_shift, output);
	ff8_battle_stage_projection = previous_stage_projection;

	return result;
}

int16_t ff8_battle_world_calc_zoom(int16_t *descriptor, int16_t **vertices, uint32_t **projected_vertices)
{
	const int16_t clip_x = descriptor[10];
	const int16_t clip_width = descriptor[12];
	const int16_t clip_height = descriptor[13];
	int16_t *const source_begin = *vertices;
	uint32_t *const projected_begin = *projected_vertices;
	// The End's custom scenery uses native Y projection; its actors must use the same coordinates.
	const bool native_vertical_projection = ff8_battle_active_effect != nullptr
		&& *ff8_battle_active_effect == ff8_the_end_effect;

	if (getmode_cached()->driver_mode == MODE_BATTLE)
	{
		const int wide_right = wide_viewport_x + wide_viewport_width;
		const int half_bottom = static_cast<int>(ceil((wide_viewport_y + wide_viewport_height) / 2.0));
		const int half_left = static_cast<int>(floor((wide_viewport_x - wide_viewport_width) / 2.0));
		const int half_right = static_cast<int>(ceil((wide_right + wide_viewport_width) / 2.0));

		descriptor[10] = static_cast<int16_t>(half_left);
		descriptor[12] = static_cast<int16_t>(half_right - half_left);
		if (descriptor[11] + descriptor[13] < half_bottom)
			descriptor[13] = static_cast<int16_t>(half_bottom - descriptor[11]);
	}

	const int16_t result = ff8_externals.world_calc_zoom_sub_50F900(descriptor, vertices, projected_vertices);
	if (ff8_battle_stage_projection && clip_height > 0)
	{
		const int vertex_count = *source_begin;
		const int zoom = ff8_externals.camera_zoom_dword_1CA92E4[0];
		const int near_guard = zoom / 8;
		const int clip_left = 8 * descriptor[10];
		const int clip_top = 8 * descriptor[11];
		const int clip_right = clip_left + 8 * descriptor[12];
		const int clip_bottom = clip_top + 8 * descriptor[13];

		for (int vertex_index = 0; vertex_index < vertex_count; ++vertex_index)
		{
			const int16_t *const source = source_begin + 1 + 3 * vertex_index;
			uint32_t *const projected = projected_begin + 2 * vertex_index;
			if ((projected[1] & 0x20000) != 0)
			{
				const double precise_x = ff8_externals.dword_1CA9290[0]
					+ ff8_externals.flt_1CA9234[0] * source[2]
					+ ff8_externals.flt_1CA9234[1] * source[1]
					+ ff8_externals.flt_1CA9234[2] * source[0];
				const double precise_y = ff8_externals.dword_1CA9290[1]
					+ ff8_externals.flt_1CA9234[3] * source[2]
					+ ff8_externals.flt_1CA9234[4] * source[1]
					+ ff8_externals.flt_1CA9234[5] * source[0];
				const double precise_z = ff8_externals.dword_1CA9290[2]
					+ ff8_externals.flt_1CA9234[6] * source[2]
					+ ff8_externals.flt_1CA9234[7] * source[1]
					+ ff8_externals.flt_1CA9234[8] * source[0];
				const int projected_z = static_cast<int>(round(precise_z));

				if (projected_z > near_guard)
				{
					int projected_x = 8 * ff8_externals.word_1CA92DE[0] + static_cast<int>(round(8.0 * precise_x * zoom / projected_z));
					int projected_y = 8 * ff8_externals.word_1CA92DE[2] + static_cast<int>(round(8.0 * precise_y * zoom / projected_z));
					if (projected_x < -8192) projected_x = -8192;
					if (projected_x > 8184) projected_x = 8184;
					if (projected_y < -8192) projected_y = -8192;
					if (projected_y > 8184) projected_y = 8184;

					projected[0] = static_cast<uint16_t>(projected_x) | (static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<uint16_t>(projected_y)) << 16);
					projected[1] &= ~(0x20000 | 0x3F00000);
					if (projected_x < clip_left) projected[1] |= 0x1100000;
					else if (projected_x > clip_right) projected[1] |= 0x1200000;
					if (projected_y < clip_top) projected[1] |= 0x2400000;
					else if (projected_y > clip_bottom) projected[1] |= 0x2800000;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if (getmode_cached()->driver_mode == MODE_BATTLE && clip_height == 216 && !native_vertical_projection)
	{
		const int clip_top = 8 * descriptor[11];
		const int source_height = 8 * clip_height;
		const int target_height = 4 * (wide_viewport_y + wide_viewport_height) - clip_top;

		for (uint32_t *projected = projected_begin; projected < *projected_vertices; projected += 2)
		{
			const int projected_y = static_cast<int16_t>(*projected >> 16);
			int scaled_y = static_cast<int>(round(clip_top + (projected_y - clip_top) * static_cast<double>(target_height) / source_height));
			if (ff8_battle_stage_projection)
			{
				const int target_center = clip_top + target_height / 2;
				scaled_y = static_cast<int>(round(target_center + (scaled_y - target_center) * static_cast<double>(target_height) / source_height));
			}
			if (scaled_y < -32768) scaled_y = -32768;
			if (scaled_y > 32767) scaled_y = 32767;
			*projected = (*projected & 0xFFFF) | (static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<uint16_t>(scaled_y)) << 16);
		}
	}
	descriptor[10] = clip_x;
	descriptor[12] = clip_width;
	descriptor[13] = clip_height;

	return result;
}

static uint32_t *ff8_worldmap_projected_vertices;

int ff8_worldmap_project_vertices(int vertex_count)
{
	// World-map packet Y=0 maps to screen Y=16.
	const int clip_left = 4 * wide_viewport_x;
	const int clip_right = clip_left + 4 * wide_viewport_width;
	const int clip_top = 4 * (wide_viewport_y - 16);
	const int clip_bottom = clip_top + 4 * wide_viewport_height;
	static std::vector<uint8_t> visibility;

	if (vertex_count > 0)
	{
		visibility.resize(vertex_count);
		const int zoom = static_cast<uint16_t>(*ff8_externals.camera_zoom_dword_1CA92E4);
		const int center_x = 8 * ff8_externals.word_1CA92DE[0];
		const int center_y = 8 * ff8_externals.word_1CA92DE[2];
		const float *const rotation = ff8_externals.flt_1CA9234;
		const int *const translation = ff8_externals.dword_1CA9290;

		// Test both full coordinates before the native projector overwrites them with 16-bit values.
		for (int vertex_index = 0; vertex_index < vertex_count; ++vertex_index)
		{
			const int16_t *const source = reinterpret_cast<const int16_t *>(ff8_worldmap_projected_vertices + 2 * vertex_index);
			// Match the native single-precision intermediate before integer projection.
			const float camera_x = static_cast<float>(rotation[0] * (8.0 * source[2])
				+ rotation[1] * (8.0 * source[1])
				+ rotation[2] * (8.0 * source[0])
				+ 8.0 * translation[0]);
			const float camera_y = static_cast<float>(rotation[3] * (8.0 * source[2])
				+ rotation[4] * (8.0 * source[1])
				+ rotation[5] * (8.0 * source[0])
				+ 8.0 * translation[1]);
			const double camera_z = rotation[6] * static_cast<double>(source[2])
				+ rotation[7] * static_cast<double>(source[1])
				+ rotation[8] * static_cast<double>(source[0])
				+ translation[2];
			const bool perspective = std::nearbyint(camera_z) > (zoom >> 1);
			const double scale = perspective ? static_cast<double>(zoom) / camera_z : 0.0;
			const double projected_x = center_x + (perspective
				? std::nearbyint(scale * camera_x)
				: 2.0 * std::nearbyint(camera_x));
			const double projected_y = center_y + (perspective
				? std::nearbyint(scale * camera_y)
				: 2.0 * std::nearbyint(camera_y));

			visibility[vertex_index] = (projected_x >= clip_left && projected_x < clip_right ? 1u : 0u)
				| (projected_y >= clip_top && projected_y < clip_bottom ? 2u : 0u);
		}
	}

	const int result = reinterpret_cast<int (*)(int)>(ff8_externals.sub_4023D0)(vertex_count);

	for (int vertex_index = 0; vertex_index < vertex_count; ++vertex_index)
	{
		uint32_t *const projected = ff8_worldmap_projected_vertices + 2 * vertex_index;

		// Only replace X/Y visibility; retain the native depth and near-plane flags.
		projected[1] = (projected[1] & ~0x30000u) | (static_cast<uint32_t>(visibility[vertex_index]) << 16);
	}

	return result;
}

static int (*ff8_worldmap_model_store_depths)(uint32_t *, uint32_t *, uint32_t *);

int ff8_worldmap_model_store_wide_depths(uint32_t *depth0, uint32_t *depth1, uint32_t *depth2)
{
	const int result = ff8_worldmap_model_store_depths(depth0, depth1, depth2);
	const int clip_left = 4 * wide_viewport_x;
	const int clip_right = clip_left + 4 * wide_viewport_width;
	const int clip_top = 4 * (wide_viewport_y - 16);
	const int clip_bottom = clip_top + 4 * wide_viewport_height;

	// This projector clamps packet coordinates, so signed 16-bit X/Y cannot wrap.
	for (uint32_t *depth : {depth0, depth1, depth2})
	{
		const int x = static_cast<int16_t>(depth[-1]);
		const int y = static_cast<int16_t>(depth[-1] >> 16);
		const uint32_t visibility = (x >= clip_left && x < clip_right ? 1u : 0u)
			| (y >= clip_top && y < clip_bottom ? 0x100u : 0u);
		*depth = (*depth & 0xFFFFu) | (visibility << 16);
	}

	return result;
}

static uint32_t (*ff8_worldmap_submit_sky_quad)(int *, uint32_t *, int, int, int, int);

uint32_t ff8_worldmap_submit_wide_sky_quad(int *ordering_table, uint32_t *packet, int z0, int z1, int z2, int z3)
{
	// These two native sky-gradient packets use quarter-pixel X coordinates.
	const uint16_t left = static_cast<uint16_t>(4 * wide_viewport_x);
	const uint16_t right = static_cast<uint16_t>(4 * (wide_viewport_x + wide_viewport_width));
	for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
		packet[2 + 2 * i] = (packet[2 + 2 * i] & 0xFFFF0000u) | (i % 2 == 0 ? left : right);

	return ff8_worldmap_submit_sky_quad(ordering_table, packet, z0, z1, z2, z3);
}

using ff8_shop_draw_panel = int (*)(int, int *, int, int, int);
static ff8_shop_draw_panel ff8_shop_draw_owned;
static ff8_shop_draw_panel ff8_shop_draw_items;
static ff8_shop_draw_panel ff8_shop_draw_gil;

static int ff8_shop_wide_panel_x(int x, int visible_x)
{
	const sprite_viewport &viewport = ff8_externals.menu_viewport[2];
	const int hidden_x = static_cast<int>(ceil((wide_viewport_x + wide_viewport_width - viewport.offset_x) / viewport.scale_x));
	const int extra_distance = hidden_x > 384 ? hidden_x - 384 : 0;

	// Extend the native slide to X=384 without moving its visible endpoint.
	return x + (x - visible_x) * extra_distance / (384 - visible_x);
}

int ff8_shop_draw_wide_owned(int menu, int *graphics, int output, int x, int y)
{
	return ff8_shop_draw_owned(menu, graphics, output, ff8_shop_wide_panel_x(x, 280), y);
}

int ff8_shop_draw_wide_items(int menu, int *graphics, int output, int x, int y)
{
	return ff8_shop_draw_items(menu, graphics, output, ff8_shop_wide_panel_x(x, 24), y);
}

int ff8_shop_draw_wide_gil(int menu, int *graphics, int output, int x, int y)
{
	return ff8_shop_draw_gil(menu, graphics, output, ff8_shop_wide_panel_x(x, 24), y);
}

struct ff8_battle_packet_viewport
{
	int left, top, right, bottom;
};

static ff8_battle_packet_viewport ff8_battle_get_packet_viewport(int units)
{
	const double scale_x = 320.0 * units / *ff8_externals.ssigpu_viewport_width_dword_B7CBF8;
	const double scale_y = 240.0 * units / *ff8_externals.ssigpu_viewport_height_dword_B7CBFC;
	const int x = *ff8_externals.ssigpu_viewport_x_dword_1CA89D8;
	const int y = *ff8_externals.ssigpu_viewport_y_dword_1CA89DC;
	return {
		static_cast<int>(floor((wide_viewport_x - x) * scale_x)),
		static_cast<int>(floor((wide_viewport_y - y) * scale_y)),
		static_cast<int>(ceil((wide_viewport_x + wide_viewport_width - x) * scale_x)),
		static_cast<int>(ceil((wide_viewport_y + wide_viewport_height - y) * scale_y))
	};
}

static int (*ff8_battle_store_triangle)(uint32_t *, uint32_t *, uint32_t *);
static uint32_t *(*ff8_battle_store_fourth)(uint32_t *);
static uint32_t (*ff8_battle_submit_unprojected_quad)(int *, uint32_t *);
// Projecting a quad's fourth vertex shifts the GTE FIFO, so keep the first three packet coordinates.
static uint32_t ff8_battle_projected_vertices[4];

static int ff8_battle_store_wide_triangle(uint32_t *xy0, uint32_t *xy1, uint32_t *xy2)
{
	const int result = ff8_battle_store_triangle(xy0, xy1, xy2);
	ff8_battle_projected_vertices[0] = *xy0;
	ff8_battle_projected_vertices[1] = *xy1;
	ff8_battle_projected_vertices[2] = *xy2;
	return result;
}

static uint32_t *ff8_battle_store_wide_fourth(uint32_t *xy)
{
	uint32_t *const result = ff8_battle_store_fourth(xy);
	ff8_battle_projected_vertices[3] = *xy;
	return result;
}

template<uint32_t vertex_count>
static uint32_t ff8_battle_clip_polygon()
{
	const ff8_battle_packet_viewport viewport = ff8_battle_get_packet_viewport(8);
	uint32_t outside = 3;
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < vertex_count; ++i)
	{
		const int x = static_cast<int16_t>(ff8_battle_projected_vertices[i]);
		const int y = static_cast<int16_t>(ff8_battle_projected_vertices[i] >> 16);
		const uint32_t flags = (x < viewport.left || x > viewport.right ? 1u : 0u)
			| (y < viewport.top || y > viewport.bottom ? 2u : 0u);
		outside &= flags;
	}

	// Preserve native rejection on each axis: wrapped sky polygons must not bridge opposite screen edges.
	return outside != 0 ? (1u << vertex_count) - 1 : 0;
}

struct ff8_battle_polygon_clip
{
	uint32_t store_triangle, store_fourth, reduction, secondary_test, secondary_size;
	bool patch_compare;
};

static void ff8_battle_patch_polygon_clips(uint32_t renderer, std::initializer_list<ff8_battle_polygon_clip> clips)
{
	for (const auto &clip : clips)
	{
		replace_call(renderer + clip.store_triangle, ff8_battle_store_wide_triangle);
		if (clip.store_fourth != 0)
			replace_call(renderer + clip.store_fourth, ff8_battle_store_wide_fourth);
		// Replace only the screen rejection; retain native projection, depth and winding checks.
		replace_call_function(renderer + clip.reduction, clip.store_fourth != 0 ? ff8_battle_clip_polygon<4> : ff8_battle_clip_polygon<3>);
		if (clip.patch_compare)
			patch_code_byte(renderer + clip.reduction + 6, 0xF8); // cmp al, mask instead of cl/dl
		memset_code(renderer + clip.secondary_test, 0x90, clip.secondary_size);
	}
}

template<bool bottom>
static uint32_t ff8_the_end_submit_wide_cinema(int *ordering_table, uint32_t *packet)
{
	const ff8_battle_packet_viewport viewport = ff8_battle_get_packet_viewport(1);
	// Anchor each bar to its screen edge without changing the native animated thickness.
	const int y_offset = bottom ? viewport.bottom - 216 : viewport.top;
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
	{
		const int x = static_cast<int16_t>(packet[2 + i]);
		const int y = static_cast<int16_t>(packet[2 + i] >> 16) + y_offset;
		const int wide_x = x == 0 ? viewport.left : viewport.right;
		packet[2 + i] = static_cast<uint16_t>(wide_x) | (static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<uint16_t>(y)) << 16);
	}
	return ff8_battle_submit_unprojected_quad(ordering_table, packet);
}

static uint32_t ff8_battle_submit_wide_flash(int *ordering_table, uint32_t *packet)
{
	const ff8_battle_packet_viewport viewport = ff8_battle_get_packet_viewport(1);
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
	{
		const int x = static_cast<int16_t>(packet[2 + i]);
		const int y = static_cast<int16_t>(packet[2 + i] >> 16);
		const int wide_x = x == 0 ? viewport.left : (x == 320 ? viewport.right : x);
		const int wide_y = y == 0 ? viewport.top : (y == 240 ? viewport.bottom : y);
		packet[2 + i] = static_cast<uint16_t>(wide_x) | (static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<uint16_t>(wide_y)) << 16);
	}
	return ff8_battle_submit_unprojected_quad(ordering_table, packet);
}

static void ff8_the_end_widescreen_init()
{
	const uint32_t effect = ff8_externals.func_off_battle_effects_C81774[FF8BattleEffect::TheEnd];
	ff8_the_end_effect = reinterpret_cast<void *>(get_absolute_value(effect, 0xB));
	ff8_battle_active_effect = reinterpret_cast<void **>(get_absolute_value(ff8_externals.battle_magic_effect_start_call, 0x7));
	ff8_battle_store_triangle = reinterpret_cast<decltype(ff8_battle_store_triangle)>(get_relative_call(effect, 0x1802));
	ff8_battle_store_fourth = reinterpret_cast<decltype(ff8_battle_store_fourth)>(get_relative_call(effect, 0x1AD5));
	ff8_battle_submit_unprojected_quad = reinterpret_cast<decltype(ff8_battle_submit_unprojected_quad)>(get_relative_call(effect, 0x9082));

	// Flat, textured and Gouraud primitives, including the subdivided scenery path.
	ff8_battle_patch_polygon_clips(effect, {
		{0x1802, 0, 0x1882, 0x188B, 8, false},
		{0x1A1D, 0x1AD5, 0x1B10, 0x1B1D, 11, false},
		{0x1CE1, 0, 0x1D68, 0x1D76, 12, true},
		{0x216B, 0x222A, 0x2265, 0x2272, 15, false},
		{0x26AE, 0, 0x272E, 0x273B, 12, false},
		{0x28FE, 0x29B6, 0x29F2, 0x29FF, 15, false},
		{0x2C19, 0, 0x2CA3, 0x2CB1, 12, true},
		{0x312A, 0x31EC, 0x322A, 0x3238, 15, true},
		{0x835C, 0x841E, 0x845C, 0x846A, 15, true}
	});

	replace_call(effect + 0x9082, ff8_the_end_submit_wide_cinema<false>);
	replace_call(effect + 0x90CD, ff8_the_end_submit_wide_cinema<true>);

	// This shared flash callback emits four quarter-screen quads, not one full-screen primitive.
	const uint32_t flash_callback = get_absolute_value(effect, 0xCE5);
	const uint32_t flash_draw = get_absolute_value(flash_callback, 0x19);
	for (uint32_t offset : {0xB7u, 0xFFu, 0x147u, 0x18Eu})
		replace_call(flash_draw + offset, ff8_battle_submit_wide_flash);
}

static void ff8_battle_effects_widescreen_init()
{
	const uint32_t gilgamesh = ff8_externals.func_off_battle_effects_C81774[FF8BattleEffect::GilgameshZantetsuken];
	const uint32_t renderer = get_relative_call(gilgamesh, 0xA79);
	// Shared GTE primitive paths used by Gilgamesh's sky, swords and slash.
	ff8_battle_patch_polygon_clips(renderer, {
		{0x116, 0, 0x166, 0x170, 8, true},
		{0x3D6, 0x43C, 0x45F, 0x46C, 11, false},
		{0x65B, 0, 0x6A9, 0x6B3, 7, true},
		{0x884, 0x906, 0x92A, 0x934, 9, true},
		{0xABD, 0, 0xB0B, 0xB19, 11, true},
		{0xCB6, 0xD1C, 0xD3F, 0xD4C, 15, false},
		{0xF7A, 0, 0xFC8, 0xFD6, 11, true},
		{0x11C4, 0x1246, 0x126A, 0x1278, 13, true}
	});
}

void ff8_widescreen_hook_init() {
	ff8_card_submit_background = reinterpret_cast<decltype(ff8_card_submit_background)>(
		get_relative_call(ff8_externals.sub_5391B0, 0xC7));
	replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_5391B0 + 0xC7, ff8_card_submit_first_background_page);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_5391B0 + 0x177, ff8_card_submit_second_background_page);
	ff8_card_draw_sprite = reinterpret_cast<decltype(ff8_card_draw_sprite)>(ff8_externals.ssigpu_callbacks_1[100]);
	patch_code_dword(reinterpret_cast<uint32_t>(&ff8_externals.ssigpu_callbacks_1[100]),
		reinterpret_cast<uint32_t>(ff8_card_draw_background_sprite));
	ff8_card_append_sprite = reinterpret_cast<decltype(ff8_card_append_sprite)>(
		get_relative_call(ff8_externals.sub_462AD0, 0x9E));
	replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_462AD0 + 0x9E, ff8_card_append_background_sprite);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_462AD0 + 0x25E, ff8_card_append_background_sprite);

	if (FF8_US_VERSION)
	{
		ff8_the_end_widescreen_init();
		ff8_battle_effects_widescreen_init();
		replace_call(ff8_externals.swirl_enter + 0x111, ff8_swirl_set_wide_viewport);
		replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_5099D0 + 0xCD, ff8_battle_world_calc_zoom);
		replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_500870 + 0x760 + 0x15E, ff8_battle_stage_draw);

		const uint32_t battle_stage_init = get_relative_call(ff8_externals.sub_500870, 0x13);
		const uint32_t battle_height = (wide_viewport_y + wide_viewport_height) / 2;
		patch_code_int(battle_stage_init + 0x21, battle_height);
		patch_code_int(battle_stage_init + 0x39, battle_height);
		patch_code_int(battle_stage_init + 0x51, battle_height);
		patch_code_short(battle_stage_init + 0x85, battle_height);
		patch_code_int(battle_stage_init + 0x90, battle_height);
		patch_code_short(battle_stage_init + 0xD3, battle_height);

		const uint32_t worldmap_draw_models = get_relative_call(ff8_externals.worldmap_with_fog_sub_53FAC0, 0x267);
		const uint32_t worldmap_draw_model = get_relative_call(worldmap_draw_models, 0x5E5);
		ff8_worldmap_model_store_depths = reinterpret_cast<int (*)(uint32_t *, uint32_t *, uint32_t *)>(get_relative_call(worldmap_draw_model, 0x10D));
		replace_call(worldmap_draw_model + 0x10D, ff8_worldmap_model_store_wide_depths);
		// Keep the projection loop intact, but do not overwrite the C++ visibility flags.
		memset_code(worldmap_draw_model + 0x131, 0x90, 4);
		memset_code(worldmap_draw_model + 0x14D, 0x90, 4);
		memset_code(worldmap_draw_model + 0x172, 0x90, 4);

		const uint32_t worldmap_draw_sky = get_relative_call(ff8_externals.worldmap_with_fog_sub_53FAC0, 0xA78);
		const uint32_t worldmap_draw_sky_gradient = get_relative_call(worldmap_draw_sky, 0x1BA);
		ff8_worldmap_submit_sky_quad = reinterpret_cast<decltype(ff8_worldmap_submit_sky_quad)>(get_relative_call(worldmap_draw_sky_gradient, 0xDE));
		replace_call(worldmap_draw_sky_gradient + 0xDE, ff8_worldmap_submit_wide_sky_quad);
		replace_call(worldmap_draw_sky_gradient + 0x1A7, ff8_worldmap_submit_wide_sky_quad);

		const uint32_t shop_render = get_absolute_value(reinterpret_cast<uint32_t>(ff8_externals.menu_callbacks[11].func), 0x34);
		ff8_shop_draw_owned = reinterpret_cast<ff8_shop_draw_panel>(get_relative_call(shop_render, 0x241));
		ff8_shop_draw_items = reinterpret_cast<ff8_shop_draw_panel>(get_relative_call(shop_render, 0x26B));
		ff8_shop_draw_gil = reinterpret_cast<ff8_shop_draw_panel>(get_relative_call(shop_render, 0x279));
		replace_call(shop_render + 0x241, ff8_shop_draw_wide_owned);
		replace_call(shop_render + 0x26B, ff8_shop_draw_wide_items);
		replace_call(shop_render + 0x279, ff8_shop_draw_wide_gil);
	}

	// Viewport fixes
	replace_function(ff8_externals.engine_setviewport_sub_45B4C0, ff8_engine_set_wide_viewport);

	ff8_worldmap_projected_vertices = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t *>(get_absolute_value(ff8_externals.sub_4023D0, 0xAA) - 4);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_53BB90 + (FF8_US_VERSION ? 0x402 : 0x410), ff8_worldmap_project_vertices);
	replace_call(ff8_externals.sub_53BB90 + (FF8_US_VERSION ? 0xAB1 : 0xAE5), ff8_worldmap_project_vertices);

	const int worldmap_clip_top = 4 * (wide_viewport_y - 16);
	const int worldmap_clip_height = 4 * wide_viewport_height;
	memset_code(ff8_externals.worldmap_fog_filter_polygons_fallback + 0x1D9, 0x90, 2);
	// The fallback's unsigned Y tests also reject negative packet coordinates in the top strip.
	patch_code_int(ff8_externals.worldmap_fog_filter_polygons_fallback + 0x1E0, worldmap_clip_top + worldmap_clip_height);
	patch_code_byte(ff8_externals.worldmap_fog_filter_polygons_fallback + 0x1E8, 0x7E); // jle
	patch_code_byte(ff8_externals.worldmap_fog_filter_polygons_fallback + 0x1EE, 0x7E); // jle
	patch_code_byte(ff8_externals.worldmap_fog_filter_polygons_fallback + 0x1F5, 0x8F); // jg
	if (FF8_US_VERSION)
	{
		memset_code(ff8_externals.worldmap_cull_blocks_sub_53D3C0 + 0x3A2, 0x90, 2);
		memset_code(ff8_externals.worldmap_cull_blocks_sub_53D3C0 + 0x3A8, 0x90, 2);
	}

	// Menu
	ff8_externals.menu_viewport[2].scale_x = 2.0;
	ff8_externals.menu_viewport[2].offset_x = -64.0;
}

static void ff8_expand_screen_overlay(struct nvertex *vertices, uint32_t vertexcount, float minimum_height = 0.0f)
{
	float min_x = vertices[0]._.x;
	float max_x = vertices[0]._.x;
	float min_y = vertices[0]._.y;
	float max_y = vertices[0]._.y;

	for(uint32_t i = 1; i < vertexcount; ++i)
	{
		if(vertices[i]._.x < min_x) min_x = vertices[i]._.x;
		if(vertices[i]._.x > max_x) max_x = vertices[i]._.x;
		if(vertices[i]._.y < min_y) min_y = vertices[i]._.y;
		if(vertices[i]._.y > max_y) max_y = vertices[i]._.y;
	}

	if(vertexcount == 4)
	{
		// Projected scenery also uses TL quads; only expand screen-aligned, constant-depth rectangles.
		for(uint32_t i = 0; i < vertexcount; ++i)
		{
			if((vertices[i]._.x != min_x && vertices[i]._.x != max_x)
				|| (vertices[i]._.y != min_y && vertices[i]._.y != max_y)
				|| vertices[i]._.z != vertices[0]._.z
				|| vertices[i].color.w != vertices[0].color.w)
				return;
		}
	}

	if(max_x - min_x < game_width || floor(max_y - min_y) < floor(minimum_height)) return;

	float wide_min_x = min_x < wide_viewport_x ? min_x : wide_viewport_x;
	float wide_max_x = max_x > wide_viewport_x + wide_viewport_width ? max_x : wide_viewport_x + wide_viewport_width;

	for(uint32_t i = 0; i < vertexcount; ++i)
	{
		if(vertices[i]._.x == min_x) vertices[i]._.x = wide_min_x;
		if(vertices[i]._.x == max_x) vertices[i]._.x = wide_max_x;

		if(vertexcount == 4)
		{
			if(vertices[i]._.y == min_y) vertices[i]._.y = wide_viewport_y;
			if(vertices[i]._.y == max_y) vertices[i]._.y = wide_viewport_y + wide_viewport_height;
		}
	}
}

void ff8_widescreen_adjust_vertices(uint32_t mode, uint32_t vertextype, struct nvertex *vertices, uint32_t vertexcount, uint16_t *indices, uint32_t count)
{
	if(!widescreen_enabled) return;

	if (mode == MODE_CARDGAME && vertextype == TLVERTEX && !current_state.texture_handle
		&& vertexcount == 4 && count == 6)
	{
		for (const auto &background : ff8_card_backgrounds)
		{
			if (background.drawn && background.frame == frame_counter)
			{
				ff8_expand_screen_overlay(vertices, vertexcount, game_height - 48.0f);
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	if(mode == MODE_SWIRL && vertextype == TLVERTEX)
	{
		const float scale_x = wide_viewport_width / static_cast<float>(game_width);
		const float scale_y = wide_viewport_height / static_cast<float>(game_height);

		for(uint32_t i = 0; i < vertexcount; ++i)
		{
			vertices[i]._.x = wide_viewport_x + vertices[i]._.x * scale_x;
			vertices[i]._.y = wide_viewport_y + vertices[i]._.y * scale_y;
		}
	}

	if(vertextype == TLVERTEX && mode == MODE_WORLDMAP
		&& ((vertexcount == 8 && count == 12) || (vertexcount == 4 && count == 6)))
	{
		ff8_expand_screen_overlay(vertices, vertexcount);
	}

	if(vertextype == TLVERTEX && mode == MODE_BATTLE
		&& vertexcount % 4 == 0 && count / 6 == vertexcount / 4 && count % 6 == 0)
	{
		// SSIGPU batches screen overlays with other quads, so classify each primitive, not the draw.
		bool is_quad_batch = true;
		for(uint32_t base = 0, index = 0; base < vertexcount; base += 4, index += 6)
		{
			for(uint32_t i = 0; i < 6; ++i)
			{
				if(indices[index + i] < base || indices[index + i] >= base + 4)
				{
					is_quad_batch = false;
					break;
				}
			}
			if(!is_quad_batch) break;
		}
		if(is_quad_batch)
		{
			// A full-width strip is not a full-screen flash (The End's cinema bars share these batches).
			const float screen_height = *ff8_externals.ssigpu_viewport_height_dword_B7CBFC * (216.0f / 240.0f);
			for(uint32_t base = 0; base < vertexcount; base += 4)
			{
				// Native packets without projection depths use RHW=1; do not widen batched 3D scenery.
				if(vertexcount == 4 || vertices[base].color.w == 1.0f)
					ff8_expand_screen_overlay(vertices + base, 4, screen_height);
			}
		}
	}

}

void ff8_widescreen_framebuffer_capture(uint32_t &x, uint32_t &w)
{
	if (widescreen_enabled)
	{
		if (getmode_cached()->driver_mode == MODE_BATTLE)
		{
			// Battle feedback already uses the wide viewport; its origin is relative to the 4:3 canvas.
			x -= wide_viewport_x;
		}
		else
		{
			// Match the capture rectangle to the widescreen-scaled swirl geometry.
			x = std::lround(double(x) * wide_viewport_width / game_width);
			w = std::lround(double(w) * wide_viewport_width / game_width);
		}
	}
}
```

```cpp
/****************************************************************************/
//    Copyright (C) 2026 Julian Xhokaxhiu                                   //
//                                                                          //
//    This file is part of FFNx                                             //
//                                                                          //
//    FFNx is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify          //
//    it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by  //
//    the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License         //
//                                                                          //
//    FFNx is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,               //
//    but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of        //
//    MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.  See the         //
//    GNU General Public License for more details.                          //
/****************************************************************************/

#include "../globals.h"
#include "../ff8.h"
#include "../patch.h"
#include "world.h"

#include <array>

static uint32_t *ff8_worldmap_model_depths;
static int16_t *ff8_worldmap_model_triangle_depth_scale;
static int16_t *ff8_worldmap_model_quad_depth_scale;
static uint32_t (*ff8_worldmap_model_submit)(int *, uint32_t *, int, int, int, int);

template<int vertex_count>
static uint32_t ff8_worldmap_submit_model_polygon(int *ordering_table, uint32_t *packet, int, int, int, int)
{
	std::array<int, 4> depths = {};
	const uint32_t depth_scale = static_cast<uint32_t>(vertex_count == 3
		? *ff8_worldmap_model_triangle_depth_scale
		: *ff8_worldmap_model_quad_depth_scale);

	// AVSZ3 uses SZ1-SZ3; AVSZ4 uses SZ0-SZ3. Match the native scale for each packet type.
	for (int vertex = 0; vertex < vertex_count; ++vertex)
	{
		const uint32_t raw_depth = static_cast<uint16_t>(ff8_worldmap_model_depths[4 - vertex_count + vertex]);
		depths[vertex] = (vertex_count * raw_depth * depth_scale) >> 13;
	}

	// The caller has already culled the polygon and chosen its native average-depth sorting bucket.
	return ff8_worldmap_model_submit(ordering_table, packet, depths[0], depths[1], depths[2], depths[3]);
}

void ff8_worldmap_model_depth_init()
{
	const uint32_t draw_models = get_relative_call(ff8_externals.worldmap_with_fog_sub_53FAC0, FF8_US_VERSION ? 0x267 : 0x268);
	const uint32_t draw_model = get_relative_call(draw_models, FF8_US_VERSION ? 0x5E5 : 0x63A);
	const uint32_t draw_quads = get_relative_call(draw_model, FF8_US_VERSION ? 0x313 : 0x345);
	const uint32_t average_triangle_depth = get_relative_call(draw_model, FF8_US_VERSION ? 0x274 : 0x29B);
	const uint32_t average_quad_depth = get_relative_call(draw_quads, FF8_US_VERSION ? 0x105 : 0x107);
	ff8_worldmap_model_depths = reinterpret_cast<uint32_t *>(ff8_externals.dword_1CA8A50);
	ff8_worldmap_model_triangle_depth_scale = reinterpret_cast<int16_t *>(get_absolute_value(average_triangle_depth, 0x31));
	ff8_worldmap_model_quad_depth_scale = reinterpret_cast<int16_t *>(get_absolute_value(average_quad_depth, 0x35));
	ff8_worldmap_model_submit = reinterpret_cast<decltype(ff8_worldmap_model_submit)>(get_relative_call(draw_model, FF8_US_VERSION ? 0x2E0 : 0x30A));
	replace_call(draw_model + (FF8_US_VERSION ? 0x2E0 : 0x30A), ff8_worldmap_submit_model_polygon<3>);
	replace_call(draw_quads + (FF8_US_VERSION ? 0x181 : 0x187), ff8_worldmap_submit_model_polygon<4>);
}
```

```cpp
//    GNU General Public License for more details.                          //
/****************************************************************************/

#include "chara_one.h"
#include "../../image/tim.h"
#include "../../log.h"

std::vector<CharaOneModelTextures> ff8_world_chara_one_parse_models(const uint8_t *chara_one_data, size_t size)
{
	std::vector<CharaOneModelTextures> models;

	const uint8_t *cur = chara_one_data + size, *min_cur = chara_one_data + 4;

	// The header is at the end of the file
	uint32_t count;
	cur -= 4;
	memcpy(&count, cur, 4);

	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count && cur >= min_cur; ++i) {
		CharaOneModelTextures textures;

		uint32_t tim_offset;

		while (cur >= min_cur) {
			cur -= 4;
			memcpy(&tim_offset, cur, 4);

			if (int32_t(tim_offset) < 0) {
				break;
			}

			textures.push_back(tim_offset & 0xFFFFFFF);
		}

		models.push_back(textures);

		cur -= 4; // Skipping offset to the model data
	}

	return models;
}

bool ff8_world_chara_one_model_save_textures(const std::vector<CharaOneModelTextures> &models, const uint8_t *chara_one_model_data, const char *dirname)
{
	if (trace_all || trace_vram) ffnx_trace("%s: %s\n", __func__, dirname);

	int model_id = 0;
	for (const CharaOneModelTextures &textures: models) {
		int texture_id = 0;
		for (uint32_t texture_pointer: textures) {
			char name[MAX_PATH] = {};
			snprintf(name, sizeof(name), "%s/model%d-%d", dirname, model_id, texture_id);
			Tim tim = Tim::fromTimData(chara_one_model_data + texture_pointer);

			if (!tim.save(name, 0, 0, true)) {
				return false;
			}
			++texture_id;
		}
		++model_id;
	}

	return true;
}
```

```h
/****************************************************************************/
```
